Trusted by nearly 7,500 customers, including 75 of the Fortune 500, Druva helps safeguard the critical information and systems businesses depend on in an increasingly connected world.

Visit druva.com and follow us on LinkedIn, X and Facebook.

**About the Team**

We are a high-energy, close-knit team that operates with speed, precision, and a relentless focus on results! Though small, our impact is huge—we collaborate closely, support each other, and drive excellence across every stage of the hiring journey.

**Role Purpose & Impact**

The Talent Acquisition Operations Coordinator plays a critical, candidate-facing role in driving operational excellence across our recruiting processes and delivering an exceptional candidate experience. As a key brand ambassador for Druva, this role is essential to our hiring success—coordinating interviews, managing direct candidate interactions, and ensuring a best-in-class, high-touch experience from first touch to offer. You will also lead efforts to optimize talent acquisition systems, processes, and reporting. The ideal candidate is highly organized, has excellent communication skills, is passionate about creating efficient processes, enjoys working collaboratively, and thrives in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

**What You’ll Do**

* Coordinate and schedule interviews between candidates, recruiters, and hiring managers.
* Serve as the main point of contact for onsite interviews, managing logistics, ensuring interviewer readiness, and creating a positive candidate experience.
* Champion a top-tier, highly personal candidate experience in close collaboration with recruiters, sourcers, hiring managers, and interviewers by ensuring timely follow-ups, warm candidate interactions, and clear communication throughout the interview lifecycle.
* Manage job postings across various platforms (company website, job boards, and social media).
* Manage candidate records in the Applicant Tracking System (ATS).
* Assist with pre-employment screenings, background checks, and reference verifications.
* Assist in the preparation of offer letters and onboarding materials.
* Track and report hiring metrics such as time-to-fill and candidate conversion rates.
* Support talent operations efforts and processes to improve team efficiency and scalability.
* Assist with cross-functional initiatives, including onboarding support and collaboration with other HR functions to enhance talent acquisition effectiveness.
* Track key candidate experience metrics, create insightful reports, and support data-driven decision-making across the recruiting team.
* Support employer branding and talent branding initiatives to elevate Druva’s reputation as an employer of choice across social channels and recruiting campaigns.

**What Makes You a Great Fit**

* 2+ years of experience in talent acquisition, recruiting operations, or a candidate-facing HR role with a strong focus on candidate experience, systems, and process management.
* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related field (preferred).
* Proficiency in tools such as Google Workspace and ATS platforms (Greenhouse preferred) is strongly desired.
* Knowledge of recruitment workflows, ATS administration, and recruiting metrics.
* Detail-oriented with exceptional organizational, problem-solving, and project management skills.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with a focus on stakeholder collaboration and candidate engagement.
* Proactive mindset with excellent ownership, follow-through, and the ability to prioritize and multi-task in a fast-paced environment.
* Experience managing coordination for high-priority roles, supporting onsite interview programs, or collaborating with external agencies.
* Ability to leverage AI to enhance operational efficiency, applying strong critical thinking and sound judgement to ensure output quality, accuracy, and strategic alignment.

#### **What Success Looks Like**

**Job Description:**

The **Customer Success Coordinator** is an experienced professional who owns the day-to-day coordination and operational execution of defined customer success workflows. The role ensures customer commitments, feedback, and cross-functional actions are documented, analyzed, routed, and completed, and recommends practical improvements when processes or outcomes are not meeting expectations.

  

Reporting to the Senior Manager of Customer Success, this role works independently on varied issues that require judgment, evaluation of available information, and adaptation of established approaches. Work is reviewed at key points. The coordinator partners with Customer Success, Sales, Product, Engineering, Operations, and senior internal and customer stakeholders, tailoring communication to the audience and helping influence timely resolution of customer priorities.

  

The role also supports Voice of Customer programs, including NPS and other customer feedback initiatives, and turns customer input into clear themes, reporting, and recommendations for improvement.

  

**Responsibilities**
====================

  

**Customer Coordination and Issue Resolution**
----------------------------------------------

  

* Own tracking and follow-through for customer commitments, decisions, risks, and action items across assigned initiatives; identify delays and drive clear next steps with accountable partners.
* Coordinate customer-related work across Sales, Engineering, Product, Operations, and other teams, ensuring requests and concerns reach the right owners and receive timely attention.
* Assess unusual or cross-functional issues, gather and evaluate available information, identify likely causes or gaps, and recommend a course of action; escalate material risks when needed.
Facilitate internal and customer-facing discussions as appropriate, adapt communication to differing audiences, and explain customer priorities in a way that supports alignment and resolution.  

  

**Documentation and Knowledge Management**
------------------------------------------

  

* Maintain accurate customer records, meeting outcomes, decisions, and supporting documentation so teams can access reliable, current information.
* Maintain and improve customer success knowledge resources in Confluence and create or manage Jira tickets for customer requests, initiatives, and follow-up work.
* Apply consistent documentation practices and identify information gaps or process variations that could affect customer outcomes or execution.
* **Voice of Customer and Reporting**
  -----------------------------------
* Coordinate NPS and other customer feedback activities, including survey setup, distribution, response tracking, and follow-up using SurveyMonkey or similar tools.
* Organize and analyze customer feedback and operational data to identify recurring themes, emerging concerns, and opportunities for improvement.
Prepare clear reports and recommendations that communicate customer sentiment, relevant context, and potential actions to Customer Success and cross-functional partners.  

  

**Operational Improvement and Program Support**
-----------------------------------------------

  

* Own assigned Customer Success reporting and operational tracking, ensuring information is accurate and deadlines are met.
* Prepare materials and coordinate inputs for customer business reviews and internal planning meetings.
* Evaluate existing workflows and recommend or implement practical improvements that strengthen efficiency, accountability, and customer experience.
Contribute to special projects and initiatives, adapting established approaches to address changing needs and incomplete information.  

  

**Qualifications**
==================

  

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

  

* Bachelor’s degree in Customer Success, Customer Operations, project or program coordination, account coordination, or a related professional role.
* 5+ years of experience in Customer Success, Customer Operations, project or program coordination, account coordination, or a related professional role.
* Demonstrated ability to independently manage multiple workstreams, prioritize competing requests, and deliver accurate follow-through with limited day-to-day direction.
* Sound analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to assess varied information, identify causes or risks, and recommend solutions when procedures or precedent do not fully address an issue.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to facilitate meetings, document decisions and actions, and adapt communication to different internal and external audiences.
* Experience partnering across teams and building productive relationships with stakeholders, including senior partners or customer contacts.
Proficiency with Confluence and Jira, and strong working knowledge of Microsoft Office and/or Google Workspace.  

  

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

  

* Experience supporting Customer Success or other customer-facing teams.
* Familiarity with NPS programs, customer experience practices, and customer feedback analysis.
* Experience with SurveyMonkey or similar survey platforms and CRM tools such as Salesforce.
Exposure to SaaS, technology, or service-based organizations.  

  

**What Success Looks Like**
===========================

  

* Customer commitments, risks, and action items are accurately documented, assigned, and completed on time.
* Cross-functional partners have clear visibility into customer priorities, owners, and next steps.
* Customer feedback is organized, analyzed, and communicated with useful recommendations.
* Customer records and knowledge resources remain accurate, consistent, and easy to use.
Assigned workflows and programs run reliably, with practical improvements that strengthen accountability and the customer experience.

jobs.title: Manager, GMP Quality Assurance
jobs.description:
CSBio is a peptide contract manufacturing founded in 1993. CSBio initial products were a complete line of automated synthesizers for manufacturing and process development, with a focus on cGMP production. In 1994, CSBio opened a custom peptide facility and began producing high quality compounds for research organizations and pharmaceutical companies worldwide. In 2004, CSBio opened a peptide production facility in Menlo Park, CA and in 2014, CSBio expanded production capability through the addition of a new, state of the art building dedicated to cGMP peptide production. In 2017, CSBio passed a FDA inspection and were recommended to be approved for commercial drug substance manufacturing. In 2023, additional cGMP clinical production capacity was added in Milpitas, CA.

CSBiois seeking a hands-on Quality Assurance Manager to supervise daily QA activities supporting peptide manufacturing, laboratory operations, materials, documentation, and cGMP compliance. This person will manage QA staff and directly support document review, deviations, CAPAs, change controls, training, batch-record review, audits, and inspection readiness. Core duties and responsibilities include the following:

**Job Duties:**

* + Supervise daily QA work, assign priorities, review completion, train staff, and provide practical guidance on cGMP documentation and quality-system requirements.
  + Review executed batch records, laboratory records, equipment and cleaning records, logbooks, labels, and supporting documentation for completeness and compliance.
  + Manage or support deviations, investigations, CAPAs, change controls, nonconformances, complaints, and effectiveness checks; ensure actions are documented and completed on time.
  + Coordinate document control, SOP issuance, periodic review, archival, forms, templates, and controlled-copy practices.
  + Support employee training assignments, completion tracking, qualification records, and documentation of GMP readiness.
  + Partner with Manufacturing, QC, Materials, Facilities, Validation, Regulatory, and management to resolve quality issues and prevent avoidable delays.
  + Provide QA review and approval of validation plans, risk assessments, protocols, reports, and qualification documentation for facilities, utilities, equipment, processes, cleaning, analytical methods, and software systems.
  + Work with system owners to maintain a practical validation assessment plan and address gaps in current or legacy validation documentation using documented risk-based decisions.
  + Support supplier qualification, material-status decisions, quality agreements, vendor documentation, and supplier corrective actions as assigned.
  + Manage or support customer-complaint investigations and approved recall or product-withdrawal procedures, including documentation, reconciliation, and authorized notifications.
  + Conduct or coordinate internal audits, floor observations, documentation reviews, and follow-up of findings.
  + Prepare QA records and subject-matter experts for customer audits and regulatory inspections; track requests, responses, observations, and commitments.
  + Monitor practical QA metrics such as overdue investigations, CAPAs, change controls, document reviews, training, batch-record review, and recurring documentation errors.
  + Escalate product-quality, patient-safety, data-integrity, compliance, and release risks promptly to authorized Quality leadership.
  + Improve QA workflows, templates, training, and quality-system usability without transferring QC laboratory or Manufacturing ownership into QA.

  
**Requirements**  

* Bachelor’s degree in life sciences, chemistry, engineering, pharmacy, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
* 5+ years of Quality Assurance or closely related cGMP experience in pharmaceutical, biotechnology, peptide, API, sterile, medical-device, or other regulated manufacturing.
* 2+ years of supervisory, lead, or functional-management experience, including work assignment, training, review, and employee development.
* Hands-on experience with deviations, CAPAs, change controls, document control, training, batch-record review, audits, and inspection readiness.
* Working knowledge of cGMP documentation, data integrity, traceability, quality risk, and cross-functional escalation.
* Working knowledge of applicable FDA and ICH expectations and risk-based validation practices.
* Strong judgment, written communication, investigation, organization, and follow-through skills.

  
**Benefits**  

* Medical, dental, and vision insurance (Kaiser HMO or BlueShield PPO. Employer pays 85% for Employee and 50% for Employee’s family; Dental: Aetna Dental, Delta Dental, Guardian Dental, MetLife Dental. Vision: VSP and Aetna EyeMed)
* Basic life ($20,000 paid by company) and supplemental life insurance (optional supplemental).
* Disability insurance 50% standard employer paid.
* 401k 10% 1:1 match
* PTO policy. 10 days PTO
* Companywide paid holiday during: Week of July 4, Thanksgiving (2 days), Week of December 25
* Carpool, clean air vehicle, and cell phone reimbursement
* Employee rewards and recognition program
* Company organized social events
* Quarterly sponsored team building activities

Security Officer Customer Care Patrol

**Overview**
------------

Allied Universal®, North America’s leading security and facility services company, offers rewarding careers that provide you a sense of purpose. While working in a dynamic, welcoming, and collaborative workplace, you will be part of a team that contributes to a culture that positively impacts the communities and customers we serve.

  

**Job Description**
-------------------

As a **Security Officer Customer Care Patrol** in **Mountain View, CA**, you will serve and safeguard clients in a range of industries such as Healthcare, and more. As an Unarmed Patrol Officer in a healthcare setting, you will conduct routine patrols, maintain a visible presence to help deter security-related incidents, and support a welcoming environment for patients, visitors, and staff. You will provide exceptional customer service and clear communication while responding to security-related needs. Join Allied Universal, where agility, reliability, innovation, teamwork, caring, and integrity guide our work.

**Position Type: Full Time**

**Pay Rate: $25.50 / Hour**

**Job Schedule:**

Mon

Fri

**What You'll Do:**

* Provide customer service to patients, visitors, staff, and vendors by carrying out security-related procedures, site-specific policies, and appropriate emergency response activities in a healthcare setting.
* Respond to incidents, alarms, medical emergencies, and other critical situations in a calm, professional, problem-solving manner, following site-specific protocols.
* Conduct regular and random unarmed patrols of buildings, entrances, parking areas, and perimeter locations to help deter unauthorized activity and identify security-related concerns.
* Monitor access points and report suspicious activity, facility hazards, and policy violations to appropriate personnel.
* Prepare accurate reports and maintain clear communication with site contacts, Allied Universal leadership, and emergency responders as needed.

* Customer service experience is preferred.
* A guard card or license is preferred.

* **Smart Tools:** Access to our exclusive technology to view and claim additional shifts to earn more.

* **Financial and Health Benefits:** Enjoy access to a retirement savings plan, plus medical, dental, vision, basic life and AD&D, and disability insurance.

jobs.title: Patient Services Rep II
jobs.description:
If you're ready to be part of our legacy of hope and innovation, we encourage you to take the first step and explore our current job openings. Your best is waiting to be discovered.

Day - 08 Hour (United States of America)**This is a Stanford Medicine Partners job.**  
  
**A Brief Overview**  
Under general supervision, operates as part of the care team performing a variety of functions such as greeting patients, patient registration, insurance coverage and eligibility verification, scheduling and telephone management. The PSR II performs PSR I duties, in addition, acquires job skills to complete substantive assignments/tasks of moderate scope and complexity; exercises judgment within defined guidelines and practices to determine appropriate actions; executes work in an assigned area to develop expertise needed to be fully functional in an assigned specialty area/clinic.
  
  
**Locations**  
Stanford Medicine Partners
  
  
**What you will do**

* C-I-CARE
* Executes world class practices of service and patient care in support of C-I-CARE standards.
* Uses C-I-CARE templates and the following components for all communication with patients and staff:
* CONNECT with people by calling them their proper name, or the name they prefer (Mr., Ms., Dr.)
* INTRODUCE yourself and your role
* COMMUNICATE what you are going to do, how long it will take, and how it will impact the patient
* ASK permission before entering a room, examining a patient or undertaking an activity
* RESPOND to patient’s questions or requests promptly; anticipate patient needs
* EXIT courteously with an explanation of what will come next
* Job Scope
* Performs independently all of Level I, in addition, but not limited to the following:
* Greets patients and others entering the department in a courteous and professional manner in accordance with performance standards.
* Registers new patients and updates existing patient accounts in a courteous and professional manner in accordance with performance standards.
* Schedules new or follow-up appointments in a courteous and professional manner in accordance with performance standards.
* Identifies accepted insurance plans and those requiring referrals.
* Determines if patient has a co-payment or deposit; accepts and records receipt of payment; provides applicable waiver and obtains appropriate signature; and, when appropriate, scans copy of patient’s photo ID, insurance card and/or waiver.
* Resolves any system red flags as they are encountered.
* Responds to requests from patients, family members, physicians and staff in a courteous and professional manner in accordance with performance standards.
* Facilities communication between the patients and the physicians or clinic.
* Delivers basic knowledge regarding clinic-specific processes.
* Accurately documents and routes calls to the appropriate department(s).
* Manages flow of information received from various sources to appropriate staff member. May handle and deliver requests for approvals requiring signatures or input, lab reports, correspondence, dictations, and medical records.
* Accesses EHR to communicate to clinical staff members and/or physicians through telephone encounters using SBAR format and/or appropriate smart phrases in accordance with performance standards.
* Manages EHR in-basket(s), work queues and schedule templates as assigned in accordance with performance standards.
* Balances cash sheet and cash drawer, completes daily deposit summary and prepares monthly deposit summary in accordance with performance standards.
* Assists with master scheduling template for the department.
* Specialized scheduling/referral coordination.
* Floats as needed.
* Provides orientation and training to new staff as assigned.
* Serves as a job expert in assigned areas, taking on additional special assigned duties.
* Knowledge
* Same as Level I and, in addition:
* Requires the ability to apply knowledge to perform work.
* Prioritizes own tasks.
* Level of Supervision
* Continues to develop knowledge and skills. Work is reviewed for accuracy and completeness.
* Assignments are selected to provide increased complexity and variety within the specialty area.
* All other duties as assigned including department-specific functions and responsibilities:
* Performs other duties as assigned and participates in organization projects as assigned.
* Adheres to safety, P4P’s (if applicable), HIPAA and compliance policies.

  
**Education Qualifications**

* High school graduate or equivalent required.

  
**Experience Qualifications**

* One (1) year of PSR or related experience required.
* Graduate of a Medical Receptionist training program, healthcare experience, or related preferred.
* EPIC experience preferred.

  
**Required Knowledge, Skills and Abilities**

* Same as Level I and, in addition:
* Strong verbal/written communication and listening skills; including excellent interpersonal skills and telephone communication.
* Ability to maintain composure during challenging interpersonal interactions.
* Legible handwriting.
* Basic math skills necessary to collect payments and balance cash drawer.
* Basic computer skills to include keyboarding, mouse movement and data entry skills to enter information into practice management system and EHR.
* Proficient user for clinical computers systems.
* Ability to effectively organize and prioritize tasks in order to complete assignments within the time allotted and maintain standard workflow.

jobs.title: Program Manager II, Supply Chain, Google Cloud
jobs.description:
### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 2 years of experience managing projects.
* Supply Chain operations experience in asset management, manufacturing, procurement, commodity management, or supplier management.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience leading cross-functional process improvement.
* Experience in data modeling, trend analysis, statistics, forecasting, or business insights.
* Knowledge of the tools and elements of project management with the ability to be an influential member of a highly integrated team composed of both technical and non-technical members.
* Demonstrated sense of accountability and ownership for project lifecycle with the ability to collaborate and influence across multiple levels of an organization.
* Ability to shift between detailed analysis and big picture thinking and to customize communication based on the audience with excellent analytical skills.

**About the job**
-----------------

A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Program Manager at Google, you’ll lead complex, multi-disciplinary projects from start to finish — working with stakeholders to plan requirements, manage project schedules, identify risks, and communicate clearly with cross-functional partners across the company. Your projects will often span offices, time zones, and hemispheres. It's your job to coordinate the players and keep them up to date on progress and deadlines.

Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
  
  
US: $132000 - $189000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits  
  
Learn more about benefits at Google.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Develop short and long-term supply and demand models that seek to minimize total costs and inventories while maintaining/improving service levels. Present recommendations to leadership, manage timely decisions, and ensure clear and concise communication to all stakeholders in the supply chain.
* Establish and utilize best methods (i.e., statistical models, processes, software tools) in evaluating supply chain’s ability to meet customer demand.
* Work cross-functionally and manage resolution of supply chain exceptions/escalations.
* Manage cross-functional projects to implement and improve capabilities across the organization.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. jobs.title: Key Account Manager
jobs.description:
**GET TO KNOW US:**

FM Industries can promise you an environment that not only encourages your best, but also rewards it with plenty of room to grow. FM industries is a premier manufacturing solutions provider. We specialize in build to print, precision machined components, anodizing and engineered thermal spray coatings. We provide customers leading edge support from protype to production.

FM Industries has locations in Fremont and Livermore, CA with multiple shift opportunities!

Days: Mon-Fri 6:00am to 2:30pm; Swing: Mon-Fri 2:00pm to 10:30pm; Weekends: Fri-Sun 8am to 8pm

**Key Account Manager**
-----------------------

### **Position Summary**

The Strategic Account Manager serves as the primary commercial and operational interface between the company and key semiconductor customers. The role is responsible for managing customer relationships, driving demand and supply alignment, resolving supply chain escalations, coordinating cross-functional teams, and ensuring successful execution of customer commitments related to delivery, quality, pricing, and capacity planning.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* Manage strategic customer relationships and serve as the primary point of contact for assigned accounts.
* Lead regular customer business reviews, operational reviews, and executive account updates.
* Monitor customer forecasts, demand trends, and capacity requirements to support production planning.
* Drive backlog reduction and shipment recovery activities through cross-functional coordination.
* Manage supply chain escalations, material shortages, delivery risks, and customer commitments.
* Coordinate internally with planning, operations, engineering, quality, procurement, finance, and program management teams.
* Support contract pricing reviews, negotiations, and commercial account activities.
* Track key performance metrics including backlog, on-time delivery, forecast accuracy, inventory, and customer satisfaction.
* Lead risk identification and mitigation efforts related to supply continuity and revenue protection.
* Manage customer audits, quality initiatives, first article approvals, and corrective action programs.
* Support strategic initiatives including inventory optimization, supplier development, cost reduction, and capacity expansion planning.
* Prepare executive summaries, business reviews, presentations, and action plans for leadership and customers.

### **Skills & Competencies**

* Strategic Account Management
* Customer Relationship Management
* Supply Chain Management
* Forecasting & Demand Planning
* Operations Management
* Program Management
* Executive Communication
* Contract & Pricing Management
* Risk Management
* Semiconductor Manufacturing Knowledge
* Cross-Functional Leadership
* Negotiation & Conflict Resolution

### **Education & Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Supply Chain Management, Operations, Engineering, or a related field.
* 7+ years of experience in Account Management, Strategic Customer Management, Supply Chain, Operations, or Program Management, preferably within semiconductor, electronics, or advanced manufacturing industries.
* Proven experience managing multi-million-dollar customer accounts, leading cross-functional teams, and driving successful customer outcomes.
* Strong knowledge of forecasting, demand planning, supply chain management, contract administration, and executive-level customer engagement.

***Give us your best and we’ll give you ours!***

jobs.title: ABA Mid-Level Program Manager (Paid BCBA Supervision)
jobs.description:
**Job Summary: ABA Mid-Level Program Manager (Paid BCBA Supervision)**

Gain the hands-on experience, individualized mentorship, and clinical guidance to help you grow into a confident BCBA!

At Joyscape Therapy, we're looking for an experienced ABA clinician who is passionate about working with children and families and interested in continuing to develop their clinical skills. Our Program Managers receive individualized BCBA supervision and mentorship while gaining meaningful experience across the full clinical process, including developmental assessments, treatment planning, program development, parent training, and clinical decision-making.

At Joyscape, we practice naturalistic, play-based, neurodiversity-affirming ABA. All of our mid- and high-level clinicians work directly with clients/caregivers rather than relying on traditional RBT-supervision models. We value clinical curiosity, meaningful caregiver collaboration, and individualized care. If you're looking for a supportive team that will invest in your professional development and provide opportunities to grow as a clinician, we'd love to meet you!

**Why Work with Us?**

* **Paid BCBA Supervision:** Receive individualized supervision and ongoing mentorship from experienced BCBAs as you work toward certification.
* **Professional Development:** Build your clinical skills through hands-on experience with assessments, treatment planning, program development, data analysis, and parent training.
* **Flexible Scheduling:** Enjoy flexibility in structuring your schedule while maintaining a consistent full-time position (30 hours for full time benefits!)
* **Small Caseloads:** Work with a manageable caseload tailored to your experience and clinical interests.
* **Direct 1:1 Client Interaction:** Provide individualized, play-based ABA therapy and develop meaningful relationships with clients and families.
* **Supportive Team Culture:** Collaborate with experienced BCBAs and other clinicians who value growth, innovation, and employee well-being.

**As a Program Manager at Joyscape, you will:**

* Provide high-quality, ethical, family-centered, direct 1:1 ABA therapy to clients of varying ages and backgrounds.
* Implement individualized treatment plans and develop meaningful, functional, and developmentally appropriate treatment goals.
* Participate in comprehensive developmental and behavioral assessments, including caregiver interviews and standardized assessment tools.
* Develop skills in assessment interpretation, treatment planning, and clinical report writing with BCBA mentorship.
* Provide parent training and caregiver coaching, supporting families in implementing strategies and promoting client progress across environments.
* Collect and analyze session data, monitor client progress, and collaborate with supervising BCBAs to modify treatment goals and programs as clinically indicated.
* Develop and implement proactive, supportive behavior strategies that prioritize communication, autonomy, and emotional well-being.
* Collaborate with other clinicians, including OT, ST, PT, and teachers when applicable.
* Participate in regular supervision, mentorship, and professional development opportunities.
* Contribute to clinical program development and participate in internal initiatives such as social skills groups, research and education, and other special projects.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in a related field required. Master's degree in related field recommended.
* Currently enrolled in and actively completing coursework in a qualifying master's degree program in ABA, Psychology, Education, or a related field, OR recently certified as a BCBA.
* Experience providing direct naturalistic ABA services.
* Experience conducting developmental and/or behavioral assessments.
* Experience providing parent training, caregiver coaching, and family support.
* Experience with treatment goal development, program implementation, and clinical documentation.
* Experience with NDBI, ESDM, and/or PRT preferred.
* Familiarity with assessment tools such as ESDM, VB-MAPP, Vineland-3, SSIS, or similar measures preferred.
* Strong written and verbal communication, organization, and collaboration skills.
* A positive, enthusiastic attitude and genuine interest in working with children and families.
* Valid driver's license, reliable transportation, and auto insurance for driving to sessions.
* **Full-time availability of 30–40 hours per week is required** to support consistent supervision, mentorship, and client programming.

*Newly certified BCBAs are welcome to apply! Joyscape offers a separate clinical training and mentorship pathway for newly certified BCBAs transitioning into independent clinical practice.*

**Benefits:**

* Competitive hourly compensation with raise opportunities every 6 months based on performance.
* Paid BCBA supervision and individualized mentorship, as well as paid group trainings.
* Guaranteed cancellation time paid at your regular rate/stable hours and schedule.
* Paid non-billable time for trainings, committee opportunities, and mentor meetings.
* Paid sick and vacation time, as well as 8 annual paid holidays.
* Group Health, Dental, and Vision insurance (including One Medical Membership) for eligible full-time employees.
* FSA and HSA
* 401k Participation
* Company-issued iPads and keyboards
* Annual team retreats and off-site socials throughout the year.
* Generous stipend for training and continuing education outside of Joyscape.

Joyscape serves families in and around the San Jose area and greater Bay Area, California. This position involves working in clients' homes and schools in the San Jose area, as well as working at our center, located in San Jose: 1054 S De Anza Blvd #105, San Jose, CA 95129

**Please apply by emailing employment@joyscapetherapy.com with your resume and cover letter. We look forward to hearing from you!**

Pay: $35.00 - $40.00 per hour

Expected hours: 30.0 – 40.0 per week

jobs.title: Senior CX Operations Lead
jobs.description:
At Braze, we have found our people. We're a genuinely approachable, exceptionally kind, and intensely passionate crew.

We seek to ignite that passion by setting high standards, championing teamwork, and creating work-life harmony as we collectively navigate rapid growth on a global scale while striving for greater equity and opportunity – inside and outside our organization.

To flourish here, you must be prepared to set a high bar for yourself and those around you. There is always a way to contribute: Acting with autonomy, having accountability and being open to new perspectives are essential to our continued success.

Our deep curiosity to learn and our eagerness to share diverse passions with others gives us balance and injects a one-of-a-kind vibrancy into our culture.

If you are driven to solve exhilarating challenges and have a bias toward action in the face of change, you will be empowered to make a real impact here, with a sharp and passionate team at your back. If Braze sounds like a place where you can thrive, we can't wait to meet you.

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**
------------------

* Own Operational Processes: Own and continuously improve the operational processes and business requirements within the ES and PS divisions. Serve as an expert in Services Process best practices, with strong knowledge of the B2B SaaS business operations that underpin a CX Services group (e.g., services scoping and delivery, partner enablement and qualification, resource and capacity planning, and services revenue and utilization), to proactively identify bottlenecks and manual pain points, and design scalable solutions that drive efficiency.
* Deliver Operational Improvement: Lead high-impact operational programs that improve business processes and ensure alignment with departmental and company OKRs.
* Establish Data-Driven Excellence: Collaborate with the Data Engineering Enterprise Platform team (DEEP) to establish and maintain reporting frameworks that provide senior leadership with actionable insights into operational efficiency. Champion a data-driven approach, empowering teams to leverage analytics to inform their daily operations.
* Cross-Functional Leadership: Act as a trusted advisor and liaison between the CX business and key operational and technical teams. This includes regular partnership with leaders in CX business divisions and serving as a liaison with our Program Management team.
* Influence Stakeholder Partnerships: Build and maintain strong, collaborative relationships with other departments, including GTM Operations (to define and drive best-practice frameworks), and the CBO Enablement team. Collaborate with the Business Systems (BZS) team, including Salesforce Administration to support the prioritization of key initiatives for Support and Services.
* Solution Design: Liaise closely with the BZS team, building well-honed specifications and requirements documents from business cases, then working with BZS to generate elegant, scalable technical solutions. You will be responsible for defining the "what," "why," and contributing to the "how" of systems implementation. Work with Growth Engineering teams to design and build AI solutions that improve efficiency within an Operations environment.
* Change Management: Help build the change management strategy for new processes or systems, including leading internal documentation efforts and partnering with the CBO Enablement team to ensure organization-wide training and adoption.
* Technical Acumen: Possess an advanced understanding of the systems and tools used by CX, including Salesforce and other relevant platforms. Be comfortable with complex datasets and advanced analytics to support strategic process analysis.
* Lead Through Influence: Bring strong leadership qualities to a role without direct reports, working closely with both upstream and downstream teams to guide decisions, build alignment, and foster a culture of continuous improvement.

**WHO YOU ARE**
---------------

You are a solutions-focused subject matter expert in CX Operations, with a strong command of B2B SaaS business operations for CX Services organizations. You are a passionate, methodical problem-solver with a profound knack for translating complex operational challenges into clear, actionable plans.

* You have a proven track record of designing and delivering operational programs that have resulted in meaningful efficiency improvements.
* You possess an independent and results-oriented mindset, are methodical in your approach to identifying systemic challenges, measuring impact, and tracking key metrics, and have a proven ability to lead and inspire others.
* You have exceptional written and verbal communication skills, and are comfortable presenting to and influencing senior stakeholders.
* You are inquisitive about new technologies, and you always want to 'get under the hood' to see how your team could potentially benefit from early adoption.
* You are a highly collaborative individual, able to build consensus and align multiple senior stakeholders and both upstream and downstream teams toward a common goal.
* You are a completer/finisher who is comfortable working autonomously and taking the initiative to drive efficiencies and streamline operations on a global scale.
* You have strong experience with datasets and advanced data analysis using industry tooling, and advanced proficiency with Salesforce.
* You have a strong work ethic and take full responsibility for resolving complex issues with minimal guidance from your manager.
* 5+ years of relevant experience in an Operations or Process Improvement role, preferably within a SaaS company. Preferably 3-4 years of experience with B2B SaaS business operations supporting a CX Services group, including professional/expert services delivery, partner services and partner programs, client implementation, and technical support workflows.
* A proven ability to manage complex, divisional projects and operational excellence

OpenAI, Google, DoorDash, and Stripe use Within to transform how they transform. We shipped GPT-4 document chat within 12 hours of OpenAI's API launch.

We move fast, reward agency, and care deeply about our customers, our team, and our mission.

**At Within, You Will Thrive If**
---------------------------------

* **Velocity:** You're seeking a culture of rapid iteration and constant change that turns into lasting impact.
* **Agency:** You're seeking a role where you can take initiative and embody ownership.
* **Care:** You hold yourself to high standards, and enjoy close collaboration with others who care deeply and hold themselves to equally high standards.
* **Energy:** You bring drive and optimism to everything you do. You thrive on finding creative solutions to ambiguous problem statements.

------------------

Own a $7M–$15M book of enterprise AI accounts and move them from signed contract to realized, provable value — fast.

* **Outcome-oriented and scrappy:** You hypothesize, hustle, and hone — and treat a stalled account as a puzzle to solve, not a status to report.

**Bonus:** prior Forward Deployed Engineer, Solutions Engineering, or Applied AI experience; Six Sigma or formal change-management training.

------------------

* **Own portfolio health end-to-end:** Run point on a $7M–$15M book of enterprise accounts sourced through Sales — renewal, expansion, and day-to-day relationship, from kickoff through steady state.
* **Drive time-to-value:** Own structured onboarding and implementation sprints that get customers to their first AI-driven outcome fast, with the same discipline as a 30-day milestone model.
* **Partner with Forward Deployed Engineering:** Work shoulder-to-shoulder with FDEs and technical implementation staff — scope the technical build, translate customer requirements, and stay close enough to catch drift before it becomes a renewal risk.
* **Run the commercial cycle with Sales:** Feed expansion and upsell opportunities directly to your AE, and jointly own the number for your book.

* **Improve the playbook:** Feed field learnings back into onboarding, enablement, and product — you're expected to make this better, not just run it as handed to you.

**Who You Might Be**
--------------------

* You've carried an enterprise book (ideally $7M–$15M) at a B2B SaaS product company and have the scar tissue to show for it.
* You've been close to a real AI/agentic deployment — you know the difference between a demo and something running in production against real customer data.

* You're commercially minded — you think in NRR, expansion pipeline, and renewal risk, not just satisfaction scores.

* You're comfortable in ambiguity — you can scope a problem, build a plan, and move without waiting for perfect information.

**What Success Looks Like — Primary KPIs**

* **NRR & GRR** across your $7M–$15M portfolio
* **Time-to-value / onboarding SLA attainment** across your engagements
* **Expansion pipeline sourced and handed to Sales**, and win rate on those opportunities
* **Account health / adoption metrics** (usage depth, breadth across the buying committee, executive engagement)

-------------------------------------

* 2+ years running a physical space and the people in it: office manager, workplace or facilities coordinator, executive assistant, or a front-of-house or hospitality role with real operational scope. Startup experience is a plus, not a requirement.
* Strong organization and follow-through: you keep lists, close loops, and nothing you own runs out.

**Preferred**

jobs.title: Case Manager I, Health Systems Navigation
jobs.description:
**About Glide**

GLIDE is a nationally recognized center for social justice, dedicated to fighting systemic injustices, creating pathways out of poverty and crisis, and transforming lives. Through its integrated comprehensive services, advocacy initiatives, and inclusive community, GLIDE empowers individuals, families, and children to achieve stability and to thrive. GLIDE is on the forefront of addressing some of society’s most pressing issues, including poverty, housing and homelessness, and racial and social justice. GLIDE’s mission is to create a radically inclusive, just, and loving community mobilized to alleviate suffering and break the cycles of poverty and marginalization

**Position Summary:**

The Health Systems Navigation (HSN) Case Manager provides comprehensive, client-centered case management with a harm reduction focus to individuals who use substances. This role facilitates seamless access to and retention in a full spectrum of health services, including primary care, behavioral health, substance use treatment, and HIV/HCV/STI prevention and care. Responsibilities include conducting outreach, testing, counseling, and support groups, with a primary focus on re-engaging participants who are newly diagnosed or have fallen out of care. By managing a dedicated caseload and developing individualized care plans that prioritize client-identified goals (such as improving health, securing housing, and accessing social services), the Case Manager supports participants on their journey toward improved health, stability, and self-sufficiency.

### **Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

* Conduct client intakes and assessments to identify strengths, needs, and barriers to care.
* Develop, implement, and update individualized care plans in collaboration with clients to achieve their health, housing, income, and stability goals.
* Provide ongoing, strengths-based case management and consistent follow-up to a dedicated caseload to support progress toward care plan objectives.
* Coordinate internal and external services, including medical care, behavioral health, substance use treatment, and housing, and assist clients in obtaining vital documentation and public benefits.
* Provide confidential HIV/HCV/STI risk reduction counseling, and risk assessment and disclosure sessions using evidence-based approaches to people seeking confidential HIV/HCV/STI testing.
* Build a positive rapport with clients through the compassionate and non-judgmental application of harm reduction and trauma-informed principles.
* Serve as the primary point of contact for linkage-to-care referrals for clients who test positive for HIV/HCV/STI, ensuring a warm handoff and supportive follow-up.
* Facilitate harm reduction and health education support groups on a regular basis.
* Conduct targeted outreach and engagement in various community settings, including SROs, shelters, and via GLIDE's mobile testing team, to identify and connect with clients across SF.
* Represent GLIDE at community events, health fairs, and partner meetings to promote program services and collaborative care.
* Maintain accurate, timely, and confidential client records and case documentation in compliance with HIPAA and program standards.
* Complete all required data entry in designated databases (e.g., Salesforce) to capture contract deliverables and support reporting.
* Actively participate in care coordination meetings with internal and external partners to ensure integrated service delivery.
* Engage in regular supervision, team meetings, and professional development training.
* Prepare and submit monthly activity and data reports to capture program deliverables.
* Serve as the primary contact for linkage-to-care referrals for clients testing positive for HIV/HCV/STI, ensuring warm handoffs.
* Adhere to professional boundaries, ethical standards, and HIPAA protocols.
* Develop and prepare culturally appropriate outreach and educational materials to promote program services.
* Support and participate in the full range of HEAT program services and special events.
* Conduct consistent follow-ups (e.g., office, outreach, phone) to support client goals and document progress.

### **Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in social work, public health or related field and/or 2+ years providing harm reduction focused case management services to high-risk populations, including knowledge providing prescriptions for suboxone, naltrexone and other medications (and methadone dispensaries) used to support treatment adherence for clients who access HEAT MOUD services.
* Must have extensive knowledge of the prevention and treatment of HCV, HIV, and STIs.
* Ability to plan and implement outreach objectives in alignment with HEAT program needs and to promote HEAT program objectives.
* Ability to establish and maintain effective collaborative relationships across GLIDE programs, city agencies, and community partners across San Francisco and the wider Bay Are
* Understanding of core principles and practices of harm reduction and successfully engage clients in services and retention through the application of risk reduction counseling, strengths-based counseling techniques and trauma informed systems of care.
* Knowledge of the Social Determinants of Health (SDOH) and ability to provide culturally competent, culturally sensitive support to a diverse community of clients to help them achieve stability and self-sufficiency.
* Strong communication skills and trust-building skills are required, including comfort and proficiency with public speaking (i.e. 1:1 interaction with clients, group education, street outreach, etc.)
* Experience and training in overdose reversals, de-escalation techniques, motivational interviewing, and other relevant skills in managing chaotic environments

### **Certificates, Licenses**

* California Rapid HIV/HCV/STI test counselor certification preferred OR willingness to be trained.
* Current California driver’s license pref

jobs.title: Case Manager
jobs.description:
3rd Street Youth Center & Clinic is a community-based agency providing youth in Bayview Hunters Point with medical and behavioral health services that encourage them to make decisions that support their health, safety, and development. 3rd Street also manages a number of successful Transitional Age Youth (TAY) housing stabilization programs and one of the city's few Youth Access Points.

The Transitional Living Program (TLP) provides a stable, supportive, and developmentally appropriate residential environment for justice-involved youth ages 18–27. The program focuses on safety, healing, accountability, and growth through a low-barrier and trauma-informed approach. Youth receive individualized support aimed at improving life skills, stabilizing housing, accessing behavioral health care, completing probation requirements, and moving toward long-term independence.

Housing is time-limited, for up to 36 months under HSH's TAY Transitional Housing Length of Stay Policy. The program serves youth who are exiting custody, have high needs and high use of the criminal justice system, have urgent or emergent health concerns, and are experiencing housing instability. Referrals come through the referral system HSH established for the Just Home Project.

**Position Summary**
--------------------

The Just Home Residential Case Manager provides housing education, workforce development, and trauma-informed case management to justice-involved transitional age youth (TAY) residing in the Transitional Living Program. The Case Manager carries a caseload of no more than 20 youth (1:20 ratio), completes intakes, risk/needs assessments, and Individualized Service Plans, supports youth in meeting probation and court requirements, and begins housing navigation and exit planning to move youth into permanent housing. The role works to reduce recidivism, strengthen community connections, and equip youth with the skills, resources, and guidance needed for educational and career success. Services are delivered in line with HSH requirements, Housing First, harm reduction, and trauma-informed practice, and success is measured against HSH outcome targets such as exits to permanent housing, employment or post-secondary enrollment, income gains, and probation compliance.The following is not a comprehensive listing of the activities, duties, or responsibilities required of the Case Manager. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change, or new ones may be assigned as needed.

### **Intake, Assessment & Service Planning**

* Initiate contact with each youth within two business days of an HSH referral. If a youth does not engage after three outreach attempts over twelve business days, include HSH and any relevant partner agency and request help re-engaging.
* Welcome and engage youth as they enter the program, and complete intake and program orientation within one business day of move-in, covering program length, roles and responsibilities, participant expectations, and available services.
* Conduct risk/needs assessments and assess each youth's strengths, skills, and needs using trauma-informed and restorative practices.
* Develop an Individualized Service Plan with each youth within 30 days of enrollment, covering housing, employment, benefits, and education, and review and update it at least once per month.
* Design individual support and transition plans with youth, including independent living skills and income stability.
* Refer any youth without an active Coordinated Entry assessment within six months of enrollment.

### **Case Management & Engagement**

* Hold a caseload of no more than 20 youth (1:20).
* Complete in-person check-ins at least once per week, including required room visits, scheduled case management meetings, and drop-in hours, and provide ongoing meetings and counseling toward each youth's goals.
* Support residents in meeting probation conditions, court requirements, pretrial release conditions, and diversion agreements, using reminders, transportation coordination, and connection to peer support.
* Develop individual recidivism prevention plans that identify triggers and provide intensive support during high-risk periods, using trauma-informed approaches that account for the links between justice involvement, housing instability, and mental health.
* Offer onsite services or referrals to youth showing signs of placement instability, such as loss of benefits, rule violations, conflicts with staff or other youth, or warnings from property or program management, and help de-escalate and resolve conflicts.
* Provide crisis intervention and safety planning as needed, and take part in the program's 24/7 de-escalation and conflict resolution coverage, including room checks, wellness checks, and emergency safety checks under the program protocol developed with HSH.
* Offer support and referrals related to behavioral health and substance use, and connect youth to wellness services, including health education, prenatal care, and parent-child attachment and education for parenting youth, in-house or by referral.
* Track resident progress, service utilization, and probation compliance.

### **Referrals & Coordination**

* Provide resource brokerage and referrals, including information about services, help setting appointments and completing applications, appointment reminders, follow-up, and re-referral as needed.
* Help youth obtain and keep benefits, including cash aid, food programs, Medi-Cal, and in-home support, and solve problems that block enrollment.
* Help ensure transportation, food, and clothing are not barriers to self-sufficiency, including clothing for job re-entry.
* Coordinate cases and advocate for youth within the agency and with other community-based organizations, and support youth's existing community linkages.
* Collaborate with probation and parole officers through case conferencing to set supervision approaches that prioritize stability and growth, and work with the District Attor

jobs.title: IT Operations Associate
jobs.description:
**IT Operations Associate**

At Remota, we manage technology across its full lifecycle, from preparing new devices for deployment to processing them when they come back. Every laptop, desktop, tablet, and mobile device that comes through our doors is tracked, processed, and handled with care.

**The Role**

As an entry-level IT Operations Associate, you’ll support our day-to-day operations: processing returned devices by securely erasing data and testing, cleaning, and updating hardware so it’s ready for its next use. As you grow in the role, you’ll learn additional processes across the device lifecycle.

This is a hands-on operations role, not a help desk or IT support position. No advanced technical experience is needed. We’ll train you on our systems, tools, and procedures. Much of the work is repetitive and process-driven, so this role is a great fit for someone who likes routine, stays focused, and takes pride in getting the details right every time.

**What You’ll Do**

* Receive and check in returned devices, keeping inventory records accurate
* Securely erase data from laptops, desktops, tablets, and mobile devices using established procedures
* Test, inspect, clean, and grade returned devices
* Image, update, and configure Windows and macOS devices
* Label, organize, and package equipment for storage or shipment
* Coordinate warranty repairs with manufacturers
* Assist with inventory audits, client pickups and deliveries (driving a company vehicle), and other team projects
* Keep the work area clean, organized, and safe, including operating pallet jacks

**Required**

* High school diploma or equivalent
* Valid driver’s license with a satisfactory driving record
* Ability to lift up to 50 lbs and stand or walk for most of your shift
* Reliable attendance and strong attention to detail
* Comfort following step-by-step procedures consistently

**Nice to Have**

* Basic familiarity with Windows or macOS
* Experience in warehouse, inventory, shipping and receiving, logistics, manufacturing, or electronics refurbishment
* Flexibility to work occasional weekends during high-volume periods

**Why Remota**

You’ll gain hands-on experience with enterprise technology and learn skills in data security, hardware testing, inventory control, and device lifecycle management. These skills carry over well to a career in IT. We’re a small team where everyone’s work matters, and people who show reliability and initiative quickly take on more responsibility and more complex projects.

If you like working with technology, enjoy seeing real results from your work each day, and want to start a career in IT, we’d love to hear from you.

*Remota is an equal opportunity employer.*

* High school or equivalent (Preferred)

### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 6 years of experience in product research in an applied research setting.
* Experience in quantitative research, logs analysis, measurement and attribution, data analysis, and metrics analysis.
* Experience researching AI/ML products, Developer APIs, or technical infrastructure.
* Experience in programming languages used for data manipulation and computational statistics (e.g., Python is the preference).

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Master's degree or PhD in Human-Computer Interaction, Cognitive Science, Statistics, Psychology, Anthropology, or related field.
* 5 years of experience conducting UX research on products and working with executive leadership (e.g., Director level and above).
* Experience with code reviews.

**About the job**
-----------------

At Google, we "Focus on the user and all else will follow." As a Quantitative User Experience Researcher (Quant UXR), you make this possible. You will join a multi-disciplinary team, collaborating closely with Engineering and Product Management to create industry-leading, innovative products.  
  
You will drive impact at all stages of development by investigating user behavior through empirical methods like logs analysis, survey research, and regression. We value diverse educational experiences—from Computer Science to Psychology—and require a blend of behavioral research design, statistical proficiency, and programming skills to uncover actionable insights. Beyond the work, you will grow within a supportive Quant UXR community offering mentorship, regular meetups, and exclusive internal tools to help you thrive.

As a Senior Quantitative UX Researcher, you will drive product excellence for Alphabet’s core AI infrastructure by translating complex system telemetry into actionable user insights. As a part of the AI Enablement side of the ACE UX research team, you will execute on partnerships with AI Data and Research-to-Production (R2P). You will lead the development of next-generation measurement frameworks, leveraging advanced statistical models and agentic AI workflows to analyze system logs at scale. You will partner closely with Engineering, Product Management, and agentic developers, pioneer how we measure and optimize frictionless, high-velocity developer workflows across the AI pipeline.

Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
  
  
US: $159000 - $230000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits  
  
Learn more about benefits at Google.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Design and implement agent-assisted pipelines to parse, audit, and analyze massive-scale system logs (e.g., telemetry, clickstream, operational logs) to accelerate insight generation.
* Define, instrument, and track system-level Key Performance Indicator (KPIs), backend performance metrics, and Product Health indicators, aligning them directly with Critical User Journeys.
* Develop custom scripts, prompts, or agentic wrappers (e.g., in Python or R) to parse complex, messy infrastructure logs and transform them into digestible, statistically validated behavioral patterns.
* Lead the design and analysis of complex experiments, multivariate testing, and rollout strategies to optimize system configurations, documentation, and tooling.
* Collaborate with Infrastructure Engineers, Applied Data Scientists, and Machine Learning researchers to ensure backend pipelines are correctly instrumented for downstream agentic analysis.

jobs.description:
About GoodLeap:

GoodLeap is a technology company delivering best-in-class financing and software products for sustainable solutions, from solar panels and batteries to energy-efficient HVAC, heat pumps, roofing, windows, and more. Over 1 million homeowners have benefited from our simple, fast, and frictionless technology that makes the adoption of these products more affordable, accessible, and easier to understand. Thousands of professionals deploying home efficiency and solar solutions rely on GoodLeap’s proprietary, AI-powered applications and developer tools to drive more transparent customer communication, deeper business intelligence, and streamlined payment and operations. Our platform has led to more than $30 billion in financing for sustainable solutions since 2018.

GoodLeap is also proud to support our award-winning nonprofit, GivePower, which is building and deploying life-saving water and clean electricity systems, changing the lives of more than 1.6 million people across Africa, Asia, and South America.

#### **Position Summary:**

The Capital Markets Strategy & Operations Analyst supports the funding and sale of GoodLeap’s consumer finance loans by operationalizing revolving credit facilities, whole loan purchase agreements, and asset-backed securitizations. The Analyst manages day-to-day loan funding and sales activity, supports and maintains GoodLeap’s investor relationships, and works directly with lenders, capital partners, and their third-party vendors. Reporting to the Manager of Capital Markets Strategy & Operations, the Analyst collaborates closely with Capital Markets, Legal, Servicing, Underwriting, Product, Engineering, Finance, Accounting, and Business Development.

### **Essential Job Duties and Responsibilities:**

* Initiates whole loan sales by determining loan pool eligibility against investor criteria, then preparing and delivering loan schedules, loan agreements, and underwriting documentation to investors.
* Serves as a point of contact for investors and their vendors during loan reviews, partnering with Product, Engineering, Servicing, and Underwriting to answer questions, evaluate exceptions, and resolve them.
* Manages day-to-day activity on GoodLeap’s revolving warehouse credit facilities, including borrowing base calculations, funding requests, and covenant compliance monitoring.
* Develops and maintains Excel-based models, including the Sales Engine and Funding Engine, and drives automation by identifying process improvements, defining requirements, and helping build and maintain capital markets software solutions.
* Analyzes alternatives, makes recommendations to management, and implements consumer finance funding and sales strategies.
* Leads new investor onboarding and prepares and analyzes ongoing investor and management reporting, flagging trends and issues for leadership.

### **Required Skills, Knowledge and Abilities:**

The Analyst brings at least two years of experience in financial modeling and analysis, and at least two years in capital markets, treasury, or finance. They have advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Databricks, and AI tools (e.g., Claude), with the technical ability to manipulate and analyze large datasets and apply statistical methods to them. They communicate findings clearly, in writing and verbally, to management, investors, and other external parties. They have a solid grasp of capital markets, finance, accounting, and business operations concepts, and ideally bring experience in financial services, consumer finance, fintech, or renewable energy finance. They work well across Capital Markets, Legal, Servicing, Underwriting, Product, Engineering, Finance, Accounting, and Business Development, and represent GoodLeap professionally while building lasting relationships with funding and capital partners. Above all, they are a curious, tenacious problem solver and a strong team player.

jobs.description:
**About Turn/River**
--------------------

Turn/River Capital is a private equity firm that partners with software businesses to drive AI transformation and catalyze capital-efficient growth. As a team of equal parts software operators and investors, we have the people, data-driven playbooks and flexible capital to re-architect engineering, product, go-to-market, talent and resourcing to build enduring value. Founded in 2012 and based in San Francisco, Turn/River has $5.6bn in committed capital and invests globally with a focus on North America and Europe.

**About the Role**

You will be the analytical partner for one of our portfolio companies. Investment and Operating Leads will bring you their hardest revenue questions: why retention moved, where new customer revenue actually comes from, which pricing change is worth making. Those questions often arrive half-formed. Your job is to find the real question, get the data, build the analysis, and deliver a recommendation that holds up in front of our Ops and Investment teams, a portfolio company CEO, or firm leadership. You will sit in a pod with a Data Analytics Lead who owns the portfolio company relationship and a platform team that builds the data pipes. You own the analysis, the dashboards, the recommendation, and its revenue impact.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own value-creation analysis for your portfolio company: retention and cohorts, pricing and packaging, pipeline and funnel yield, and revenue source mapping.
* Build from raw data, not someone else’s summary. Pull and check the numbers yourself in SQL, our BI tools, and our AI agents.
* Use AI to compress your cycle time, and flag what should be automated for everyone.
* Turn findings into recommendations with a quantified revenue impact, a clear owner, and a next step.
* Support new deals and add-ons when the deal team needs speed.
* Turn any analysis that gets requested twice into a reusable template or tool for the portfolio and the whole Ops team.

**Qualifications**

* 2-4 years of experience in SaaS FP&A or strategic finance, technology investment banking, or strategy consulting with software clients.
* Command of SaaS economics: ARR bridges, gross and net retention, cohorts, pricing, and unit economics.
* Experience building models from scratch and producing output that executives can use without rework.
* Proficiency in SQL and comfort in messy, raw data; demonstrated ability to use AI tools or automation, ideally without being asked.
* Structured thinker who can break complex revenue processes into systems of components, root causes, and dependencies.
* Hands-on, execution-oriented, and accountable for results—this is a building role, not an advisory one.
* Curious, experimental operator who takes feedback well and continuously tests new approaches and technologies
* Experience owning a relationship with a CFO, CRO, or business unit leader is preferred

**Location**

* San Francisco, hybrid work model

**Compensation**

* The annual base salary range for this role is $145,000 - $155,000, taking into account numerous variable factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets, experience, training, licensure, certifications, and organizational requirements.

**Benefits and Perks**
----------------------

The below benefits are offered to full-time employees based out of our San Francisco office:

* An opportunity to make an impact across multiple high-growth tech firms
* Competitive salary and discretionary bonus
* Medical, dental, and vision insurance covered 100% for employee & dependents
* Flexible vacation policy
* 401K matching
* Paid parental leave
* Commuter benefits
* Health and Wellness benefits
* Household Services benefits
* Home Office benefits

* A company that enjoys having fun: holiday parties, annual company offsite and retreat, annual summer "work from anywhere" month

jobs.title: Program Coordinator - TASC/SHIP (Remote U.S.)
jobs.description:
The Program Coordinator- Technical Assistance Service Center(TASC) plays an important role in supporting the successful implementation of The Center’s TASC programs and initiatives focused on improving health care access, quality, and outcomes in rural and underserved communities. This position coordinates a variety of program activities, including technical assistance services, workforce and leadership development initiatives, and community engagement efforts. Working closely with Program Specialists, Program Managers, and internal teams, the Program Coordinator helps ensure program activities, deliverables, and timelines are organized, coordinated, and completed effectively.

The Program Coordinator serves as an important point of contact for assigned federal, state, and local government agencies, health care leaders, community partners, and rural health organizations. Responsibilities include coordinating meetings, training sessions, webinars, and onsite activities; preparing agendas, presentations, communications, and program materials; maintaining program documentation and data; and supporting reporting and evaluation activities. The position also assists with coordinating technical assistance services and following up with rural health organizations to monitor progress toward identified goals and improvement initiatives.

Success in this role requires strong organizational and project coordination skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. The Program Coordinator demonstrates excellent written and verbal communication skills, customer service, and the ability to build productive working relationships with internal and external partners. The position requires initiative, adaptability, sound judgment, and a willingness to identify opportunities to improve processes and program effectiveness. A commitment to teamwork, continuous learning, and The Center’s Mission and Core Values is essential.

**Education and Experience**

An associate’s degree, bachelor’s degree, or equivalent combination of education, training, and experience is required. Relevant fields of study include health care, health administration, public health, health education, public administration, business, or a related discipline. Candidates should have at least two years of experience in health care delivery, health planning, hospital management, marketing, community development, network development, program evaluation, or a related area.

An equivalent combination of education, training, and experience will be considered.

**Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities**

The successful candidate will demonstrate strong organizational, communication, and customer service skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities, maintain accurate documentation, and produce professional written materials with attention to spelling, grammar, and detail. Proficiency in Microsoft Office and SharePoint products is important, along with the ability to learn and use program management, communication, and data systems.

The position requires the ability to communicate clearly and confidently, respond appropriately to questions and requests from external partners, and build and maintain productive relationships. Candidates should be comfortable coordinating and facilitating meetings, presenting information through webinars and in-person presentations, and working collaboratively with diverse groups. The ability to maintain focus under pressure, adapt to changing priorities, respond constructively to feedback, and demonstrate initiative in identifying solutions and improving work processes is essential.

A commitment to teamwork, professional development, innovation, and continuous improvement is expected.

**Travel and Physical Requirements**

This position requires national travel of up to 50%, including direct and multi-city flights, overnight stays. The role involves prolonged periods of sitting/standing and working at a computer, with occasional lifting of up to 35 pounds. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the position.

Other duties may be assigned as needed.
