jobs.description:
Overview:

**Who We Are**

**Because health is personal.** That's why Personify Health created the first and only personalized health platform—bringing health plan administration, holistic wellbeing solutions, and comprehensive care navigation together in one place. We serve employers, health plans, and health systems with data-driven solutions that reduce costs while actually improving health outcomes. Together, our team is on a mission to empower people to lead healthier lives.

Learn even more about the work that drives us at personifyhealth.com.

Responsibilities:

#### **Ready to be the go-to expert who turns stop loss complexity into reimbursement wins?**

**Why This Role Matters**

Every self-funded plan we serve depends on getting stop loss right, and that starts with someone who knows the contracts inside and out. As Stop Loss Lead, you’re the department’s technical authority, the person who makes sure eligible reimbursements get submitted, tracked, and collected instead of left on the table. Your audits catch problems early, your training makes the whole team sharper, and your process improvements make every claim move faster and cleaner. The stronger your expertise and the quality of your work, the stronger our reimbursement outcomes, our client relationships, and the department as a whole.

**What You’ll Actually Do**

* **Serve as the stop loss authority:** Act as the department’s subject matter expert on administration, reimbursement, and contract interpretation, giving the team a trusted source for answers on complex questions.
* **Dig into contracts and carrier requirements:** Review stop loss contracts, plan documents, and carrier requirements in depth to ensure compliance and capture every reimbursement opportunity available.
* **Drive reimbursements to resolution:** Support the submission, tracking, and reconciliation of stop loss claims, and work aging items, carrier inquiries, disputes, and escalated cases through to closure.
* **Audit for quality:** Conduct regular reviews of claim submissions, reimbursement tracking, documentation, and correspondence to confirm accuracy and completeness, then report results and performance metrics to leadership.
* **Turn findings into fixes:** Spot recurring errors, trends, and process gaps in audit results, develop corrective action recommendations, and partner with leadership to put them in place.
* **Build and coach the team:** Onboard new Stop Loss Specialists, create and maintain training materials and standard operating procedures, and deliver coaching and refresher sessions that close knowledge gaps.
* **Improve how we work:** Evaluate workflows, lead or support process improvement initiatives, and help roll out new tools and best practices, including testing and validating system updates.
* **Own reporting and audit readiness:** Review and help prepare monthly stop loss and reimbursement reporting and carrier submissions, support internal and external audit requests, and keep documentation accurate and current.
* **Step in where it counts:** Process stop loss claims and handle related operational work when workflow demands require it, and contribute to special projects that advance department goals.

  
Qualifications:

**What You Bring to Our Team**

**Education & Experience:**

* High School Diploma or equivalent required; Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree preferred
* 3-5 years of experience in stop loss, self-funded health plan administration, claims, or related healthcare required
* Advanced claims processing and reimbursement experience strongly preferred
* Experience interpreting stop loss contracts and plan documents preferred
* Experience conducting audits, quality reviews, or process improvement initiatives preferred
* Experience training or mentoring team members preferred

**Technical Skills:**

* Advanced knowledge of stop loss administration, reimbursement processes, and contract interpretation
* Working knowledge of medical terminology and CPT, HCPCS, and ICD-10 coding (preferred)
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Word, Outlook, and reporting tools
* Auditing and data analysis skills, including identifying trends and building data-driven recommendations

**Benefits**

**The Highlights:**

* Competitive base salary and benefits effective day one
* Comprehensive medical and dental through our own health solutions (yes, we use what we build)
* Unlimited PTO—rest and recharge time is non-negotiable
* Mental health support, retirement planning, and financial protection
* Professional development with clear career progression and learning budgets
* Mission-driven culture where diverse perspectives drive real impact on people's health

**Want the full picture?** Visit personifyhealthbenefits.com to explore our complete benefits package, wellness programs, and other employee perks.

**Compensation:** This position offers a base salary range of $65,000 - $73,000, depending on location, skills, and experience. You're eligible for our full benefits package starting day one.

**Our Commitment:** Personify Health is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging. We cultivate a work environment where differences are celebrated, and employees of all backgrounds are empowered to thrive—because diversity is core to who we are and critical to our work in health and wellbeing.

**Stay Safe:** Personify Health will never ask for payment or sensitive personal information like social security numbers during hiring. All official communication comes from verified company email addresses and or our secure applicant tracking system. Suspicious requests? Report them to talent@personifyhealth.com. View all legitimate openings at personifyhealth.com/careers.

jobs.title: Deputy Project Manager
jobs.description:
**Who We Are:**

Headquartered in Washington, DC, Versar Global Solutions provides full mission lifecycle solutions for challenges faced by our government and commercial Customers in the natural, built, and digital environments. With team members around the world and a rich legacy spanning more than 50 years, Versar Global Solutions delivers a broad array of planning, analysis and risk management solutions, project and program management, operations and maintenance services, and information technology applications for environmental management and remediation projects, mission critical facilities and installations, and in support of readiness and contingency operations.

**Who You Are:**

The Assistant Project Manager supports the Project Manager in planning and executing projects required in the performance of a United States Army Corps of Engineers (USACE) Recurring Maintenance and Minor Repair (RMMR) task order. Duties include supporting project execution throughout its lifecycle; tracking and coordinating administrative requirements such as performance metrics, schedules, and budgets; utilizing computerized maintenance systems; ensuring clients’ or stakeholders’ requirements are met; processing of invoices; managing and guiding project team members when needed.

**What You’ll Do:**

* Support project manager in the successful performance of assigned contract, according to performance standards in the USACE Performance Work Statement (PWS).
* Support and coordinate with maintenance personnel to accomplish maintenance and repairs in accordance with government criteria and produce project deliverables in a timely manner.
* Guide assigned personnel in the performance of Service Order work for corrective maintenance and minor repairs via computerized maintenance management system (CMMS) or Microsoft Excel.
* Lead the measurement of project performance using tools and techniques to track completion of action items and develop baseline metrics of success, including burn rates, gross and net profit margins, cost variance, customer satisfaction as well as Quality, Health and Safety-related measures/trends.

* Support or lead development of technical proposals or amendments for the award of contract modifications, due to change of conditions or new asset inventory additions.
* Engage project team and support staff on financial tracking of contract line items, reconciliation of differences between company and government financial systems, and forecasts of contract financial performance to include budget forecasting.
* Conduct/attend scheduled contract meetings in support of contract performance or as requested by stakeholders.
* Participate in the hiring process, mentoring, and training staff assigned to applicable contract.
* Communicate information on contract-related issues through management and notify appropriate stakeholders. Utilize professional communications to engage Government stakeholders for needed actions, resolution of issues, or submission of deliverables.

**What You’ll Bring:**

* Five years of project management in a technical field; experience working on/with USACE projects is preferred. Experience in the DoD/Civilian fuels industry is preferred.

* Proficient in MS Office suite of tools, including Word, Excel, Database, PowerPoint, and Project.
* Ability to use/learn Quickbase, eMaint, MaintainX, Timberland and/or other software programs that manage information and schedules.
* Can work independently and is self-motivated; work well towards timelines and goals.

* Able to react to dynamic situations and retain effectiveness.
* Resolves conflicts between team and clients.
* Able to provide mentorship and guidance to subordinate or junior team members.
* Must be proficient in English, both written and verbal, to ensure effective communication and collaboration.
* Successful results of preemployment screenings, including federal background check, MVR, and drug screen.
* Comply with company drug and alcohol policy.

**Physical Demands:**

This position requires the individual to use the computer working at a desk in either an office or cubicle; must be able to talk and hear, reach with hands and arms, lift 25 pounds, sit, stand, and walk, must have close and color vision, use depth and peripheral vision, be able to adjust focus.

**Work Environment:**

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. The typical noise level is moderate, business office with computers, printers, and light traffic. Occasional field work at construction and client sites may require employee to be exposed to outdoor weather conditions, electrical and fueling facility environments. jobs.title: Integrations Program Manager
jobs.description:
Meta is seeking an Integrations Program Manager to lead complex, cross-functional integration programs that connect Meta's products, platforms, and operations at scale. In this role, you will define the strategic framework for how Meta's systems, APIs, and third-party integrations are operationalized, ensuring seamless interoperability across product lines. You will drive alignment across engineering, product, legal, and business development teams to deliver integration programs that are reliable, scalable, and positioned to support Meta's long-term platform ambitions.  
  
  

### **Integrations Program Manager Responsibilities:**

* Define and own the end-to-end program strategy for large-scale platform and product integrations, including API partnerships, third-party ecosystem onboarding, and cross-product interoperability initiatives
* Establish governance frameworks, integration standards, and operational playbooks that scale across multiple product lines and partner tiers
* Lead cross-functional alignment across Engineering, Product, Legal, Privacy, Business Development, and Operations to resolve integration blockers and drive program milestones
* Identify systemic risks and dependencies across integration portfolios and develop mitigation strategies that protect platform reliability and partner experience
* Define and track program health metrics, integration SLAs, and partner adoption KPIs, translating data into executive-level insights and strategic recommendations
* Drive organizational change by influencing integration architecture decisions and advocating for scalable, reusable integration patterns across teams
* Partner with product leads to evaluate technical feasibility of integration approaches and translate business requirements into actionable operational designs
* Build and maintain relationships with internal platform teams and external partners to anticipate integration needs and proactively shape roadmap priorities
* Lead post-launch integration reviews, identify operational gaps, and implement continuous improvement processes to increase integration reliability and partner satisfaction
* Mentor other program managers on integration program methodology, stakeholder management, and cross-functional execution best practices

  
  
  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* 8+ years of experience in technical program management, integrity or support operations, or integration management within a technology company
* Experience leading complex, multi-stakeholder integration programs involving APIs, platform ecosystems, or third-party partner onboarding
* Experience defining program governance structures, operational frameworks, and integration standards at an organizational level
* Experience using data and metrics to drive program decisions, communicate integration health, and influence executive stakeholders
* Experience working directly with engineering and product teams to translate technical integration requirements into program execution plans

  
  
  

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

jobs.description:
About Veksel

Veksel Consulting and Contracting is helping shape the future of digital infrastructure by delivering the expertise and leadership behind some of North America's most complex hyperscale and AI programs. Operating as an integrated extension of our owner's representative clients' organizations, we unite development, power strategy, design management, construction leadership, and commissioning expertise to turn ambitious infrastructure goals into reality.

Position Summary

Veksel is seeking an experienced **Senior Project Manager** to lead the day-to-day execution of complex construction projects, ensuring work is delivered safely, on schedule, within budget, and in accordance with quality standards and client expectations.

Key Responsibilities

**Project Leadership & Execution**

* Lead projects from preconstruction and procurement through construction, commissioning, and closeout.
* Establish project execution plans, objectives, milestones, and priorities.
* Coordinate with clients, owners, design teams, senior leadership, subcontractors, and vendors.
* Provide regular project updates, forecasts, and performance reports.

  

**Schedule & Cost Management**

* Manage project schedules, critical path activities, milestones, and deliverables.
* Coordinate subcontractor sequencing and develop recovery plans when needed.
* Oversee project budgets, cost forecasts, invoices, change orders, and financial reporting.
* Identify schedule and cost risks early and implement effective mitigation strategies.

  

**Construction & MEP Coordination**

* Coordinate civil, structural, architectural, mechanical, electrical, plumbing, and other construction disciplines.
* Partner with Superintendents and field teams to resolve construction challenges.
* Review drawings, specifications, RFIs, submittals, and change documentation.
* Support commissioning, testing, startup, and final project turnover.

  

**Subcontractor, Quality & Safety Management**

* Manage subcontractor and vendor relationships, performance, and contractual obligations.
* Lead project coordination meetings and ensure timely resolution of action items.
* Promote a strong safety culture and ensure compliance with OSHA, client, and project-specific requirements.
* Monitor quality assurance and quality control activities and drive timely correction of deficiencies.
* Maintain accurate project documentation and proactively manage project risks.

  

**Client & Stakeholder Relationships**

* Serve as a key point of contact for clients and project stakeholders.
* Communicate project status, financial performance, schedule impacts, and emerging risks.
* Build trusted relationships and resolve issues while keeping projects moving forward.

  

**Preconstruction Design Support**

* Participate in design coordination meetings
* Review BOD issues/changes against project schedules and budgets
* Provide constructability feedback.

  

Qualifications

  

* Minimum of a High School Diploma or GED, required.
* 7+ years of construction or project management experience.
* Demonstrated success managing complex construction projects, preferably valued at $50 million or more.
* Experience in large-scale commercial, industrial, mission-critical, or data center construction.
* Strong knowledge of construction scheduling, budgeting, procurement, contract administration, and subcontractor management.
* Experience coordinating multiple construction disciplines, including mechanical and electrical systems.
* Ability to interpret construction drawings, specifications, and contracts.
* Proficiency with construction management and scheduling tools such as Procore, Primavera P6, Bluebeam, Microsoft Project, or similar platforms.
* Excellent leadership, communication, organization, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-accountability project environment.

  

Preferred Qualifications

  

* Data center or other mission-critical construction experience.
* Experience supporting hyperscale data center clients or developers.
* Experience with commissioning, startup, and turnover of mission-critical facilities.
* Bachelor's degree in Construction Management, Engineering, or a related field.
* PMP, CCM, or another relevant construction or project management certification.
* Experience working with large general contractors, construction managers, and major subcontractors.

**About Heifer International**

In 1944, Heifer International’s founder, Dan West, began outlining a simple but groundbreaking plan to tackle hunger around the world. West, a farmer from the Midwest and Church of the Brethren member, had recently returned from feeding weary refugees during volunteer service in the Spanish Civil War.

He had seen firsthand that giving people food was a short-term solution, whereas providing them with animals offered a steady supply of nutritious food for an entire family. His philosophy still inspires Heifer’s work today. Partnering with farmers across a range of different livestock and crops, we create unique solutions to local challenges.

Today, Heifer International has operations in 19 countries around the world, working alongside local farmers, business owners and their communities, as they mobilize and envision their futures. Together, we build inclusive, resilient economies, so communities can develop effective ways to end global hunger and poverty in a sustainable way.

To date, we have supported more than 42 million farming families across Africa, Asia and the Americas and in the past five years alone. We have worked alongside 2.7 million families to close the living income gap or set them on a path to doing so. This **Onboarding & Implementation Manager** role gets new customers set up and getting value quickly. In Phase 1 it combines two jobs: building each new customer's dashboards and running onboarding for a share of new customers (about 10 a month).

In Phase 2, dashboard builds are automated and the role shifts it's time to onboarding calls and training. This phase will introduce more opportunity to be a process builder, as we begin rolling out a tech-touch onboarding tier.

Within the Member Experience Operations team, the Workforce Management function is responsible for ensuring operating teams are staffed to deliver on the world-class service Devoted is known for. That’s where you come in. The Manager for Workforce Management will play a crucial role in building, overseeing, and optimizing workforce planning and operations.

This role is a great fit for someone who is analytical, hands-on, and energized by building practical solutions in a fast-moving environment. You'll work closely with WFM and operations leadership to put workforce management systems and processes in place, and you'll be the person who makes sure they actually run well every day.

***Your Responsibilities and Impact will include:***

Remote

  

**12twenty is the leading platform for employers to connect with elite early career professionals.** Our community includes millions of students, recent graduates, and alumni from top business schools, law schools, and universities around the world. We take pride connecting our community of candidates with recruiters from top companies across industries. Come join our fast growing organization!

About the role

The Manager of Implementation & Onboarding leads 12twenty's team of four onboarding specialists and owns how every university partner gets from signed contract to confident, active use of the platform. You'll run the onboarding portfolio day to day: setting timelines, removing blockers, handling escalations, and making sure accounts move out of onboarding on schedule and in good health.
  
This is a hands-on leadership role. You'll coach a team with a mix of experience levels, build and continually improve the processes they work from, and partner closely with Sales, Account Management, Support, and Product so customers never feel a handoff. This position is fully remote.

Your role

**Lead and develop the team**

* Manage, coach, and develop a team of four onboarding specialists, from newer team members to experienced implementers.
* Assign and balance account portfolios based on capacity, complexity, and each person's strengths.
* Run weekly team meetings and regular 1:1s; set clear goals and give direct, timely feedback.
* Onboard and ramp new team members, and support hiring as the team grows.

**Own timelines and portfolio health**

* Own the onboarding portfolio from contract execution through initial adoption, with clear milestones for every account.
* Run a weekly portfolio review to track progress, surface at-risk accounts, and get stalled implementations moving.
* Hold the team accountable to time-to-value and on-time graduation from onboarding.

**Manage escalations**

* Serve as the escalation point for customer issues, scope disputes, delays, and technical blockers during onboarding.
* Partner with Support, Product, and Engineering to resolve configuration, SSO, integration, and data issues quickly.

**Build and improve process**

* Create, document, and refine the onboarding playbook: kickoff, project plans, training schedules, configuration, data setup, and go-live.
* Standardize templates, checklists, and handoff criteria so every customer gets a consistent experience.
* Build scalable, self-guided training resources and decide when to use them versus live sessions.
* Use customer feedback, CSAT, and onboarding health data to drive a continuous improvement cycle.

**Partner across the customer journey**

* Own a clean handoff from Sales into onboarding and from onboarding to Account Management.

* Continually surprise and delight customers with a proactive, customer-centric attitude.
* Other duties as assigned.

* Bachelor's degree preferred.
* 5+ years in SaaS onboarding, implementation, or customer success, or comparable experience in a university career services center paired with SaaS implementation work.
* 2+ years leading people or teams, formally or as a team lead, including coaching and performance conversations.
* A track record of managing multiple concurrent implementations to on-time delivery.
* Experience building or overhauling an onboarding or implementation process, not just running one.
* Calm, credible handling of escalations with customer stakeholders, including senior leaders.
* Clear communication across every channel (Slack, Jira, Salesforce, Zoom, etc.).
* Fluency with cloud-based tools and the ability to learn new technology quickly.
* Exceptional organization and judgment, comfort with ambiguity, and the ability to set priorities with minimal guidance.
* Experience leading a remote team.

Bonus points
  
You have one or more of the following:

* Formal project management experience or certification (PMP, CAPM, or similar)

Ongoing, you'll be measured on time to go-live, on-time graduation from onboarding, onboarding health scores, CSAT, and the growth of your team.

**Location:** Remote, US, with working hours generally aligned to Eastern Time

Our regional bank clients ($3.5B–$100B in assets) already trust Empyrean to support their balance sheet, profitability and planning decisions, and many start in one area and grow from there. As a Senior Account Manager on our Regional Banking team, you’ll own a book of about 60–65 institutions and help them expand across our risk, FPA and analytics solutions, including new solutions we’re launching every year.

### **What this role is really like**

This is a sales role first. You'll carry a revenue number and spend most of your time finding and closing expansion opportunities with clients who already know and like us. Accounts move to you about 18 months after they first sign, once they're up and running. You'll also lead renewals, which are increasingly complex negotiations on three- to five-year agreements. Our Customer Success and Support teams handle day-to-day service, so you can focus where the growth is.

### **What you'll do**

**Revenue growth and expansion**

* Own a book of about 60–65 regional bank and credit union clients, and a revenue target for growing it
* Find and close expansion opportunities across our risk, FPA and analytics solutions
* Tier your accounts by growth potential, and work the highest-potential accounts first
* Lead contract renewals end to end, from preparation and pricing through negotiation, working with our Legal team

**Client relationships**

* Build trusted relationships with CFOs, treasurers and finance teams, and run proposal and renewal presentations
* Partner with Customer Success, Support and Solution Engineers to keep clients happy, and hand off service needs so you stay focused on growth
* Coordinate responses to client due diligence and information security questionnaires with our Technology team
* Bring client feedback to Product, and use our webinars and go-to-market campaigns to start new conversations

### **What you bring**

**Must-haves**

* 5+ years of B2B sales experience in account management or as a sales executive, with a track record of hitting a revenue number
* **You grow accounts:** You can tell us how you found expansion opportunities in an existing book, and what you closed.
* **You can run a negotiation:** You've led renewals or complex contract discussions and protected value for your company.
* **You're technology-forward:** You live in your CRM and already use AI tools to plan your territory, research accounts and prepare outreach and presentations. We use Salesforce, Gong, SalesLoft, Teams and Claude, but any CRM experience is fine.
* **You know how to work across a team:** You bring in Customer Success, Legal, Solution Engineers and Product at the right time.

**Nice to have**

* Sales experience in banking or fintech
* Experience with risk, FPA or analytics solutions for banks, whether selling them or using them at a bank
* MEDDIC or a similar deal-qualification approach

### **Why Empyrean**

* Grow a book of clients who already trust us, with new solutions to bring them
* A team that uses AI every day, with tools including Claude from day one
* Ramp support: a reduced first-year target while you build your pipeline
* **Benefits:** Full-time offers from Empyrean Solutions include PTO, floating holidays, medical, dental and vision insurance, 401(k), and a variety of additional workplace perks.

**About Empyrean:** Empyrean Solutions is a leading provider of risk and performance management solutions for banks and credit unions. Our integrated platform helps institutions manage their balance sheet, run scenario planning, and analyze risk and performance in one place. Through our software and outsourced services, we work with banks and credit unions from $50 million to more than $200 billion in assets.

jobs.title: Technical Account Manager (LATAM)
jobs.description:
**Location:** Remote (US)

**﻿About frame Security:**

**﻿**Cyber threats have evolved to AI speed—legacy security training is dead. While old-school vendors push generic, tick-the-box videos, modern attacks are hyper-targeted, deepfake-driven, and evolving daily.

At Frame Security, we’re setting a new standard. Our AI-native platform learns an organization’s unique DNA—its tech stack, policies, and real-world risk—to deploy personalized, hyper-realistic simulations in minutes. From developers practicing secure coding to finance teams defending against AI voice phishing, we build adaptive defense systems for modern teams.

Why join us? We aren't building another static content library; we’re building the future of human defense against AI threats. If you want to solve hard problems and help shape a category-defining company, you belong here.

**Who are we looking for?**

We are looking for a technical powerhouse with zero ego to join us as a Technical Account Manager (TAM), supporting prospects and customers across Latin America (LATAM).

This isn’t a standard sales TAM role—you’ll be our technical secret weapon across the entire customer journey. One day you’re partnering with Sales to crush a technical evaluation or Proof of Value (POV); the next, you’re live-troubleshooting with a prospect or partnering with Customer Success to ensure our enterprise customers get maximum value from Frame.

You don’t need a cybersecurity background, but you do need rock-solid technical fundamentals, unstoppable curiosity, and a knack for explaining complex technical concepts clearly in both English and Spanish. If you love jumping into the deep end to solve real problems—rather than trying to be the smartest person in the room—we want to talk to you.

**﻿Key Responsibilities:**

* Troubleshoot live issues, lead technical workshops, and break down technical roadblocks.
* Drive POVs & Deployment: Design, configure, and support customer POV environments and navigate deployment requirements (identity, SSO, email infrastructure, allowlisting).
* Partner for Growth: Work closely with Sales, Customer Success, Product, and Engineering to deliver a seamless customer experience from demo to renewal.
* Build for Scale: Turn recurring customer challenges into reusable documentation, playbooks, and insights for our Product and Engineering team**s.**

**﻿Success Metrics:**

* Revenue closed
* Customer renewals & expansion
* Achievement of company revenue and retention goals

  
Requirements:  
  

**﻿Required Skills & Experience:**

* **2–5 years** in a customer-facing technical role (Sales/Solutions Engineer, TAM, Customer Success Engineer, or similar).
* **Language Fluency:** Fluent in English and Spanish, with strong written and verbal communication skills in both languages and the ability to lead technical discussions, demos, troubleshooting sessions, and customer workshops in either language.
* **Solid Tech Fundamentals:** Hands-on experience with enterprise IT environments (identity management, SSO/SAML, Okta, Entra ID, domain/email infrastructure).
* **Grit & Curiosity:** High comfort with ambiguity, quick learning, and troubleshooting live in front of customers.
* **Low Ego, High Energy:** A strong bias for action, a collaborative spirit, and a calm, solutions-oriented presence.
* **Bonus Points:** Experience in SaaS (cybersecurity is a nice-to-have, not a requirement).

**﻿Benefits:**

* Medical, dental and vision insurance.
* Monthly connectivity reimbursement.
* Unlimited paid time off.
* 401(K) Retirement Savings Plan.

**﻿Why frame:**

* High Impact: Build and own processes from start to finish that directly impact our product and customers, affecting millions of people.
* Early-Stage Advantage: Join at the ground floor of a category-defining company. The decisions you make today will shape how the world thinks about Human Security tomorrow.
* Built to Win: Frame is backed by world-class investors, operating in a market undergoing a fundamental shift, and has the right team and product.
* Competitive Salary and Meaningful Equity: Our success is your success. Everyone has a meaningful stake in the company.

jobs.title: Enterprise Account Manager
jobs.description:

* Strong understanding of enterprise software solutions, including complex integrations and deployment strategies.
* Exceptional executive-level communication, presentation, and negotiation skills.
* Ability to build and maintain strong relationships with C-level executives and key decision-makers.
* Strategic thinker with the ability to understand complex business challenges and align them with software solutions.
* Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver exceptional customer experiences.
* Strong understanding of enterprise-level contract negotiation and management.
* Proficiency with CRM tools (Salesforce or similar) and sales enablement platforms.
* Experience with multi year enterprise contracts.
* Ability to understand and articulate complex technical concepts.
* Experience with enterprise level security and compliance requirements.

#### **You’ll Get…**

We are targeting a starting salary of $- based on the intended level for this role.

In addition to cash compensation, our total rewards package includes:

* Full medical benefits including dental and vision plans to ensure you always have the best care.
* Equity packages in the form of stock options to all employees.

At Dutchie, we’re committed to providing an environment of mutual respect where equal employment opportunities are available to all applicants and teammates without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, pregnancy, age, national origin, disability status, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. jobs.title: Program Manager, Operations Process
jobs.description:
Gatik, the leader in autonomous middle-mile logistics, is revolutionizing the B2B supply chain with its autonomous transportation-as-a-service (ATaaS) solution and prioritizing safe, consistent deliveries while streamlining freight movement by reducing congestion. The company focuses on short-haul, B2B logistics for Fortune 500 retailers and in 2021 launched the world's first fully driverless commercial transportation service with Walmart. Gatik's Class 3-7 autonomous trucks are commercially deployed across major markets, including Texas, Arkansas, and Ontario, Canada, driving innovation in freight transportation.

The company's proprietary Level 4 autonomous technology, Gatik Carrier™, is custom-built to transport freight safely and efficiently between pick-up and drop-off locations on the middle mile. With robust capabilities in both highway and urban environments, Gatik Carrier™ serves as an all-encompassing solution that integrates advanced software and hardware powering the fleet, facilitating effortless integration into customers' logistics operations.

**About the Role**

Gatik is looking for a detail-oriented, improvement-minded **Program Manager, Operations Process** to own and improve the workflows that power our autonomous trucking operations. In this role, you will lead process creation, process review, and workflow design, and maintain the templates, standards, and gates that keep quality consistent across every operational workstream. Reporting to the Sr. Manager, Operational Excellence, you will partner closely with subject matter experts across Operations, Fleet Maintenance, Safety, Training, and Engineering to turn operational knowledge into clear, standardized, scalable processes. You will be instrumental in maintaining quality and consistency while driving lean practices and continuous improvement.

This role is **remote** in the **USA,** with travel to sites.

**What You'll Do**

* **Own processes end to end.** Act as the accountable owner for assigned operational processes across workstreams, keeping them current, consistent, and aligned from start to finish.
* **Design and maintain workflows.** Build, document, and maintain operational workflows, including process maps, SOPs, RACI charts, and handoffs between teams.
* **Set templates and standards.** Create and maintain standard templates for processes, SOPs, work instructions, and change requests so documentation looks and works the same everywhere.
* **Run process gating.** Run quality gates and approvals for new and changed processes so they meet quality, safety, and readiness standards before rollout.
* **Lead process creation.** Partner with stakeholders to scope, design, and launch new processes as operations and markets grow.
* **Run process reviews.** Hold regular reviews to audit existing processes, find gaps or drift, and drive updates.
* **Partner with subject matter experts.** Work closely with SMEs to capture expertise, validate process design, and secure adoption by the teams doing the work.
* **Drive lean practices.** Apply lean tools (value stream mapping, waste elimination, standard work, root cause analysis) to simplify workflows and improve quality and efficiency.
* **Manage process change.** Own version control and change management for process updates, working with Training to make sure changes are communicated and trained before rollout.
* **Improve continuously.** Gather feedback from the field and turn it into targeted process improvements.

**What We're Looking For**

#### **Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Industrial Engineering, Operations Management, Business, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 5+ years of experience in process engineering, operational excellence, quality, program management, or business process management.
* Experience owning and maintaining processes across several teams or workstreams.
* Experience designing workflows, writing SOPs, and building documentation templates.
* Experience running process review or approval mechanisms.
* Working knowledge of lean principles and tools.
* Strong ability to work with subject matter experts and turn complex operational knowledge into clear, usable processes.
* Proficiency with process mapping and documentation tools such as Lucidchart, Visio, Miro, or Confluence.

#### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in autonomous vehicles, trucking, logistics, fleet maintenance, or other safety-critical operations.
* Lean Six Sigma Yellow or Green Belt, or equivalent lean training.
* Experience with quality management systems or frameworks such as ISO 9001.

jobs.description:

**About Nurra**

Nurra supports patients with complex healthcare needs through compassionate, personalized care coordination. We combine meaningful human connections with innovative technology to help patients feel supported, informed, and empowered to manage their health.

Through our Chronic Care Management (CCM) program, we partner with patients and their healthcare providers to coordinate care, address barriers, and help patients stay connected to the support they need between doctor visits.

**About the Role**

We're looking for an Outreach & Enrollment Specialist who is passionate about connecting with patients and excited to help build and improve our outreach and enrollment operations as Nurra grows.

This is a hands-on role that combines direct patient outreach with strategic thinking and process improvement. You'll introduce eligible patients to Nurra's CCM program, guide them through enrollment, and help create an experience that is welcoming, efficient, and patient-centered.

Beyond day-to-day outreach, you'll play an important role in shaping how our enrollment function operates. We're looking for someone who is proactive, tech-savvy, and comfortable identifying opportunities to improve workflows, leverage automation, and scale operations without losing the personal touch that makes patient care meaningful.

This position is primarily remote, with occasional travel to support in-person enrollment during new clinic launches, anticipated to total a few weeks per year.

**What You'll Do**

**Strategy & Process Improvement**

* Identify barriers to enrollment and recommend practical solutions to improve efficiency and patient experience.

**Technology & Operational Growth**

**Clinic Partnerships**

* Develop positive working relationships with clinic staff to support outreach and enrollment.
* Occasionally travel to new clinic locations to support in-person patient enrollment and clinic launches.

**What We're Looking For**

* Experience in healthcare outreach, patient enrollment, care coordination, patient navigation, or a related field.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with a genuine ability to connect with patients from diverse backgrounds.
* A compassionate, patient-centered approach and sound judgment when navigating sensitive conversations.
* Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage outreach activity, follow-ups, and competing priorities independently.
* A proactive, solutions-oriented mindset with an interest in improving processes rather than simply following existing ones.
* Comfort using technology, learning new systems, and interpreting performance data to drive improvements.
* The ability to balance hands-on patient outreach with strategic initiatives and longer-term operational goals.

**Especially Valuable**

jobs.title: Oncology Patient Navigator / Support Coach
jobs.description:
**Description**

Prosoma is a growing digital health company improving emotional and behavioral support for people living with cancer. Our programs have reached more than 22,000 patients and are validated through clinical trials and real-world use, with U.S. clinical and health-economic collaborations involving institutions like MemorialCare Todd Cancer Institute and Cedars-Sinai. We are seeking an empathetic, self-motivated **Oncology Support Coach** to deliver virtual care to patients across the U.S.

In this role, you will deliver structured digital coaching and navigation through our **Living Well Plus** program, which pairs a mobile app with high-touch human support. You will empower patients using evidence-based Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT) principles and mind-body resilience tools to help them manage distress, build coping skills, and navigate their cancer journey.

**Requirements**

* **Health Coaching & Clinical Background:** Credentialed health coach (NBC-HWC preferred or in progress), social worker (MSW/LCSW), nurse, or health educator with formal training in Motivational Interviewing and behavior change.
* **Oncology & Health Experience:** Experience supporting individuals affected by cancer or chronic illness through health coaching, patient navigation, physical therapy support, or clinical social work.
* **Navigation Training Requirement:** Completion of (or willingness to complete during onboarding) the free, self-paced online **GW Cancer Center Oncology Patient Navigator Training: The Fundamentals** (~14 hours) to meet standardized navigation competencies.
* **Scope & Safety Mastery:** Deep understanding of coaching scope boundaries, ethical standards, HIPAA, consent, and safety escalation procedures (keeping coaching distinct from formal psychotherapy or medical advice).
* **CRM & Tech Comfort:** Experience working out of CRMs, EHRs, or digital health platforms daily to record sessions, log notes, and track billable time.
* **Communication & Emotional Intelligence:** Exceptional active listening, empathy, cultural humility, and the ability to support patients through health anxiety, treatment burden, and grief.

**KEY COMPETENCIES**

* **High Emotional Intelligence:** Ability to meet patients where they are with warmth, steadiness, and sound professional judgment.
* **Active Listening & CBT Aptitude:** Skilled in using reflective listening and practical CBT/mind-body tools to help patients process anxiety and build resilience.
* **Adaptability & Tech Savviness:** Comfortable navigating digital systems and adapting support to each patient's emotional state, health literacy, and schedule.
* **Professional Integrity:** Strict commitment to patient privacy, scope boundaries, and evidence-informed practice.

**Responsibilities**

* **Patient Coaching & Engagement:** Conduct 1-on-1 virtual coaching sessions aligned with *Living Well Plus*, using Motivational Interviewing, CBT-informed coping strategies, active listening, and goal-setting to support stress management, treatment resilience, and program engagement.
* **Care Navigation & Empowerment:** Help patients identify barriers to care, organize health concerns, prepare questions for oncology visits, access approved resources, and navigate complex health needs.
* **Care Plans & Personalized Goals:** Co-create practical, patient-led goals and populate Care Plans in our CRM related to coping, daily routines, app engagement, and social support.
* **Monitoring & Safety Escalation:** Monitor standardized engagement signals and distress metrics (e.g., NCCN Distress Thermometer, PHQ-9, GAD-7) and execute protocol-driven safety escalations when needed.
* **CRM & Administrative Systems:** Maintain prompt, accurate documentation of patient interactions, call recordings, time tracking, and Care Plans within designated HIPAA-compliant CRM platforms.
* **Script & Program Feedback:** Provide ground-level feedback from patient sessions to help refine coaching scripts, workflows, and care pathways as the U.S. program grows.
* **Future Peer Mentorship:** As the U.S. coaching team expands over time, assist with onboarding, mentoring, and quality reviews for incoming coaches.

**Working conditions**

* **Compensation:** $25.00-**$30.00 per hour** (hourly contract).
* **Flexible, Autonomous Schedule:** Set your own weekly availability and manage your calendar around your life. Hours scale dynamically based on active patient session volume plus administrative documentation time.
* **Paid Onboarding:** Paid 8-hour training days during initial onboarding to complete CRM setup, clinical workflows, and required navigation training.
* **Impactful Mission:** Direct opportunity to deliver evidence-based CBT and mind-body tools to improve quality of life for cancer patients.
* Fully remote role

Pay: $25.00 - $30.00 per hour

Expected hours: 10.0 – 40.0 per week

Benefits:

* Professional development assistance

Work Location: Remote

Our member and prospect-facing teams help people navigate the complex world of health care by genuinely listening to their questions and guiding them towards the best decisions for their healthcare needs. As a Workforce Management Real Time Analyst, you have the opportunity to help us optimize capacity planning for a rapidly scaling service, outreach, and sales team nationwide.

In this role, you will be responsible for managing the inbound queue for our Member Service Guide (MSG), Telesales, and inbound and outbound Member Outreach teams using Devoted’s workforce management (WFM) and contact center platforms to ensure our front line teams can support our members. You will create standard operating procedures based on the forecasted inbound call volume and partner closely with other Member Experience and Health Plan Operations teams to ensure there is sufficient support for frontline teams to meet Devoted’s service metrics on a daily basis. You will be expected to proactively identify areas of improvement based on data and insights. This role is critical to improving the Devoted experience for both frontline teams and members alike.

As an early member of a high velocity and high performing team, you will have disproportionate influence and ownership in the establishment of culture, capabilities, and process of the team as it grows. The role will, in part, be shaped by your skill set and growth goals.

Megaport is the global leader in Network as a Service (NaaS), and has transformed the way businesses connect to the cloud, data centers, and each other. We’re publicly listed on the Australian Stock Exchange and partnered with the biggest names in tech like Amazon, Microsoft, Google, Oracle, IBM, and more. Headquartered in Brisbane with a crew of over 600 people spread across Asia-Pacific, Europe, and the Americas, our employees enjoy an environment that is collaborative, supportive, and (actually) fun.

We’re a team of problem solvers, pixel pushers, code slingers, and cloud fanatics. The position develops live-instruction materials, self-paced e-learning, hands-on exercises, job aids, assessments, and adoption-hub resources using ADDIE or SAM and tools such as Articulate Storyline and Rise. Content will be prepared for the existing learning management system and validated against accessibility requirements.

This is not a slide-production-only role. The designer must identify the performance problem behind a training request, define measurable learning objectives, test content with representative learners, and refine materials based on completion data and user feedback. The ideal candidate balances technical accuracy with adult-learning principles, concise writing, visual clarity, and Section 508 compliance.

LMI is a new breed of digital solutions provider dedicated to accelerating government impact with innovation and speed. Investing in technology and prototypes ahead of need, LMI brings commercial-grade platforms and mission-ready AI to federal agencies at commercial speed.

Leveraging our mission-ready technology and solutions, proven expertise in federal deployment, and strategic relationships, we enhance outcomes for the government, efficiently and effectively. With a focus on agility and collaboration, LMI serves the defense, space, healthcare, and energy sectors—helping agencies navigate complexity and outpace change. Headquartered in Tysons, Virginia, LMI is committed to delivering impactful results that strengthen missions and drive lasting value.

Responsibilities:

* Conduct needs analysis and translate assessed learner cohorts and job roles into measurable learning objectives.
* Design role-based courses on Agile practices, Jira Cloud, reporting, and administrative workflows using ADDIE or SAM.
* Develop instructor guides, presentations, demonstrations, exercises, assessments, e-learning modules, and concise job aids.
* Author and maintain Articulate Storyline or Rise content and package courses for SCORM-compatible LMS delivery.
* Coordinate publishing, course metadata, completion tracking, pilot testing, and revisions with LMS and training operations staff.
* Perform accessibility reviews and coordinate Section 508 and WCAG testing and remediation for self-paced content.
* Maintain consistent, version-controlled adoption-hub and knowledge-base resources.
* Create curriculum maps that connect learner role and readiness level to objectives, prerequisites, modality, activities, practice tasks, and knowledge checks.
* Script accurate Jira Cloud and Agile demonstrations with consistent terminology, realistic workflows, annotated screenshots, and accessible interaction patterns.
* Build facilitator notes, learner guides, scenario-based exercises, quick-reference cards, and assessment items that reinforce on-the-job application.
* Conduct editorial, functional, and accessibility quality assurance; document remediation decisions before course publication and updates.
* Manage content versions, review cycles, SME approvals, and content ownership so learning materials stay aligned with changing platform configurations.

Qualifications:

**Required:**

* Bachelor's degree in instructional design, education, learning technologies, educational psychology, or a related field.
* 3+ years of instructional design, e-learning development, or performance-support experience.
* Demonstrated use of ADDIE or SAM and Articulate Storyline or Rise.
* Experience with SCORM packages, LMS course publishing, and training evaluation.
* Knowledge of Section 508 and WCAG accessibility requirements and accessible content design.
* Ability to obtain and maintain a favorable Public Trust determination and satisfy applicable federal personnel vetting, security, privacy, accessibility, and data-handling requirements.
* Section 508 Trusted Tester certification or equivalent formal accessibility testing credential.
* Portfolio or work samples demonstrating both instructor-led design and interactive e-learning or digital performance support.
* Ability to collaborate with technical SMEs and translate detailed workflows into accurate, concise, and accessible learner-facing content.

**Desired:**

* Prior experience supporting the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA), Veterans Health Administration (VHA), or federal health programs is highly desirable.
* Master's degree in instructional design, education, learning technologies, or a related discipline.
* Agile, Jira Cloud, Confluence Cloud, or federal enterprise training experience.
* Experience creating blended learning for large distributed audiences.
* Experience designing simulation-based software instruction, formative assessments, and post-training performance reinforcement.
* Additional certifications such as ATD Associate Professional in Talent Development (APTD) or Certified Professional in Talent Development (CPTD) are desirable.

Target Salary Range: $85,000 - $115,000

***Disclaimer:***

The salary range displayed represents the typical salary range for this position and is not a guarantee of compensation. Individual salaries are determined by various factors including, but not limited to location, internal equity, business considerations, client contract requirements, and candidate qualifications, such as education, experience, skills, and security clearances.

Job Title: Program Coordinator – Equitable Building Decarbonization Program  
Primary Work Location: San Francisco – Bay Area (Hybrid)  
FLSA Classification: Exempt  
Projected Salary Range: $55,000 - $75,000

Overview: Association for Energy Affordability (AEA) is a rapidly growing national nonprofit energy services and training organization dedicated to reducing the carbon impact of the built environment while fostering and maintaining affordable and healthy housing and communities. Energy consulting services are completed through AEA’s participation in a variety of federal, state, and local energy programs and initiatives. For more information about AEA, see http://www.aea.us.org.

Position Summary: AEA West is seeking a Program Coordinator to join our tight-knit, talented team of “Energy Geeks”. The candidate must be passionate about energy efficiency and green building, highly organized, detail-oriented, and have strong communication skills.
  
  
The Program Coordinator will assist one or more of AEA’s Program Associates and/or Program Managers in the day-to-day operations and process flow of programs directed at providing energy efficiency and building decarbonization services for multifamily buildings. The Program Coordinator will work collaboratively with AEA’s Program Associates and/ or Program Managers who manage and support program implementation oversee and coordinate with technical staff, analyze program and pilot data, coordinate with external parties, conduct outreach and intake. The Program Coordinator engages in project scheduling, marketing and outreach, data analysis, report production, special program projects/ pilots, and database management as needed to deliver high impact energy efficiency and building decarbonization programs. They are expected to be a self-starter, an independent problem solver, and a strong team-player with a customer-service orientation.

AEA is hiring for primary work locations based in the Bay Area. Candidates must have the ability to travel within California upon request.

Responsibilities:
  
The Program Coordinator may be expected to assist with:

* Supporting energy efficiency, renewable energy and/or building decarbonization program implementation.
* Supporting technical staff conducting energy audits and in-field energy assessments, on-site diagnostics, field data collection and analysis as needed.
* Gathering, analyzing, and reporting program data such as program pipeline, measure savings, benchmarking and other utility data, project savings, regional project distribution, etc.
* Implementing special projects within a program.
* Conducting outreach and intake to program participants and stakeholders.
* Developing program materials, forms, process documents.
* Supporting invoicing and budget reconciliation
* Supporting data entry and data quality control
* Developing and updating marketing materials, email templates, presentations and websites.
* Communicating about the program to stakeholders including inquiries received from general program email inbox and hotline as well as representing the program at conferences and in-person events and tours as needed.

These job responsibilities may be revised over time to ensure the functional responsiveness of the Program Coordinator to AEA and Federal and California State program requirements.

Minimum Qualifications:  

* Bachelor’s degree or an Associate degree.
* One (1) year of related experience in a related role.
* Basic knowledge and experience in energy efficiency and green building principles.
* Strong oral and written communication skills.
* Ability to bring together various resources to work together collaboratively.
* Advanced-level knowledge of MS Word, Excel and PowerPoint.

Additional Qualifications Desired:  

* Basic knowledge and understanding of Title 24 and other building codes and standards.
* Familiarity with local, state, and federal incentive and rebate programs.
* Sound technical writing skills and experience.
* Proficiency in Salesforce.

Must be able to legally work in the country where this position is located without visa sponsorship.

**EEO Non-Discrimination and ADA Reasonable Accommodation Statement:**  
Applicants are considered for all positions without regard to race, color, creed, religion, age, national origin, immigration or citizenship status, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital or partnership status, disability, military status, veteran status, or predisposing genetic characteristics. AEA does not discriminate on the basis of physical or mental disability where the essential functions of the job can be reasonably accommodated. Determinations on requests for reasonable accommodation will be made on a case-by-case basis. For more information on the physical requirements of this position and/or if you need reasonable accommodation for any part of the application and hiring process, please notify Human Resources at 718-292-6733 ext. 8265.

We maintain an inclusive culture where everyone feels safe to contribute and help us innovate, and we encourage people from diverse backgrounds to apply to our roles.

TO APPLY: Interested applicants must submit a cover letter and resume to be considered. In your cover letter, please share examples of AEA’s past or current work that is most exciting to you and why. We will not be reviewing resumes without a cover letter.

You may find all our open positions at our Careers site here: https://aea.us.org/about/#careers

AEA offers excellent benefits, including medical/dental/vision, commuter plan, 401(k) w/matching contribution, generous PTO, educational assistance, paid parental leave, hybrid work arrangement and many development opportunities. We are also an eligible employer for student loan forgiveness.

**CASE MANAGER I and II (Tagalog)**

**Case Manager I Bilingual - $2,741.57 - $3,993.25 Bi-weekly; $71,280.82 - $103,824.50 Annual**

**Case Manager II Bilingual - $2,846.40 - $4,148.14 Bi-weekly; $74,006.40 - $107,851.64 Annual**

**New hires with no prior Regional Center work experience will start at the very beginning of the salary scale.**

**\* Please note that our new hire date is anticipated to be Monday, January 4th \***

The Regional Center of the East Bay (RCEB) is one of 21 Regional Centers that are community-based, private non-profit corporations under contract with the California Department of Developmental Services. RCEB provides intake, assessment, diagnosis, and coordinates community-based services for over 25,000 children and adults with developmental disabilities in Alameda and Contra Costa counties.

RCEB envisions a future where persons with developmental disabilities are truly a part of the community. Persons with developmental disabilities receive supports and services they need to succeed. The supports and services change as the need changes.

In our dream, children with developmental disabilities live with families in typical communities. Many choose to attend their neighborhood schools and play with neighborhood friends. Adults with developmental disabilities live in the residence of their choice – with family members, with friends, or with their spouse / significant other. They engage in activities of their choice – work, volunteering, education, training, or leisure. They have meaningful relationships with friends and coworkers and are seen as valuable, contributing members of their communities.

**Key Responsibilities**:

**Case Managers** are an integral part of realizing our dream. Under general direction, Case Managers are responsible for the entire case management process, including: assessment and evaluation, planning, authorizing, advocacy, monitoring, reviewing documentation for completion.

* Facilitate the planning process and develop the Individual Program Plan (IPP) or Individual Family Service Plan (IFSP) for assigned Consumers and oversee the implementation of the IPP/IFSP. Monitor and evaluate the services provided through the plan.

* Coordinate and support the implementation of the Consumers plan which may include identifying natural supports and generic services and evaluating when a need exists that can only be met through RCEB authorized funding.

* Advocate on behalf of consumers to protect their rights under the law and ensure that they receive those services and benefits to which they are entitled.

* Assist the consumer and family in obtaining essential diagnosis and evaluation from appropriate practitioners and secure written reports and other information which assesses and interprets the consumer's situation.

* Monitor the consumer's health and safety.

* Maintain all documentation and contacts as required by law, regulation and policy.

* Implement RCEB policies and procedures.

* Complete, in a timely manner, functional and/or developmental reviews.

* Keep supervisor informed of the status of the case load and unmet needs in the community.

* Perform other duties as assigned.

**Minimum Qualification:**

**Case Manager I**

* BA Degree in Social Work, Psychology or a related human services field and 2 years similar experience. OR B.A. in an unrelated human services field plus 4 years of experience working directly with the developmentally disabled.

* Ability to communicate clearly and effectively, verbally and in writing.

* Automobile and valid driver's license required.

* Demonstrate cultural awareness and sensitivity and an ability to work effectively with culturally diverse populations.

* Ability to speak in Tagalog.

**Case Manager II**

* Master's Degree in Social Work, Psychology or related human services field.

* Ability to communicate clearly and effectively, verbally and in writing.

* Automobile and valid driver's license required.

* Demonstrate cultural awareness and sensitivity and an ability to work effectively with culturally diverse populations.

* Ability to speak in Tagalog.

**Benefits:**

At the Regional Center of the Easy Bay, we offer a full spectrum of competitive benefits including:

* 3 weeks paid vacation + 12 sick days
* 14 paid holidays + 3 floating holidays
* Multiple options for medical care (including Kaiser at 100% employer paid for employee)
* Dental and vision plans
* CalPERs Retirement (pension),
* Student Loan Forgiveness\*
* Flex schedule, if applicable
* Work at Home schedules, if applicable
* Employee Assistance Program, including mental health care

  

*RCEB staff are mandated to be vaccinated and receive a booster, when eligible, for COVID-19, by 3/1/2022, per CA Public Health Order (PHO) and DDS directive. The EEOC and California DEFH has noted that, any person who has either (1) a medical condition or disability that prevents taking the vaccine/booster or (2) a sincerely held religious belief, practice, or observance that prevents the person from taking the vaccine/booster may be entitled to an exemption as a reasonable accommodation.*

Employees who work at least 30 hours per week for a governmental, 501(c)(3) nonprofit, or other qualifying nonprofit organization may apply to have the balance of their student loans forgiven (tax free) after making 120 monthly payments.*

new_jobs.title: Program Manager, Operations Readiness
new_jobs.description:
Gatik, the leader in autonomous middle-mile logistics, is revolutionizing the B2B supply chain with its autonomous transportation-as-a-service (ATaaS) solution and prioritizing safe, consistent deliveries while streamlining freight movement by reducing congestion. The company focuses on short-haul, B2B logistics for Fortune 500 retailers and in 2021 launched the world's first fully driverless commercial transportation service with Walmart. Gatik's Class 3-7 autonomous trucks are commercially deployed across major markets, including Texas, Arkansas, and Ontario, Canada, driving innovation in freight transportation.

The company's proprietary Level 4 autonomous technology, Gatik Carrier™, is custom-built to transport freight safely and efficiently between pick-up and drop-off locations on the middle mile. With robust capabilities in both highway and urban environments, Gatik Carrier™ serves as an all-encompassing solution that integrates advanced software and hardware powering the fleet, facilitating effortless integration into customers' logistics operations.

**About the Role**

Gatik is looking for a detail-oriented, highly organized **Program Manager, Operations Readiness** to make sure our operations teams are prepared for every change that reaches the field. In this role, you will manage readiness for software releases, hardware improvements, platform updates, operational process changes, and end-state improvement rollouts, using lean principles and standardized processes. Reporting to the Director of Central Operations, you will act as the primary conduit between Technical Engineering and Operations, and partner closely with Product, Training, and Safety so that every change is enabled, communicated, trained, and validated before launch. You will be instrumental in maintaining safety and operational continuity while driving fast, reliable delivery of improvements across our autonomous fleet.

This role is **hybrid**, **2** days per week in **Santa Clara, Phoenix, Dallas, or Toronto**.

**What You'll Do**

* **Own readiness programs end to end.** Plan and run readiness for software releases, hardware improvements, platform updates, process changes, and end-state rollouts, from early scoping through launch and post-launch stabilization.
* **Standardize the readiness process.** Build and maintain standard work, templates, checklists, and go/no-go gates so every launch follows a consistent, repeatable process.
* **Apply lean principles.** Use lean tools (value stream mapping, waste elimination, root cause analysis) to make readiness and rollout workflows faster, simpler, and less error-prone.
* **Bridge Engineering and Operations.** Act as the conduit between Technical Engineering and Operations: translate technical changes into operational impact, and bring field realities back into engineering priorities.
* **Maintain the operations triage process.** Own the triage process for issues coming out of operations, including intake, prioritization, routing to the right engineering or functional owners, and tracking to resolution.
* **Escalate field feedback.** Collect and synthesize feedback from operations teams, escalate critical issues quickly and clearly, and make sure feedback shapes future releases and improvements.
* **Partner across functions.** Work with Product, Operations, Training, and Safety to align on scope, dependencies, timelines, and owners for each change.
* **Drive training and enablement.** Coordinate with Training to make sure documentation, SOP updates, training content, and field communications are delivered and completed before launch.
* **Manage risk and safety alignment.** Work with Safety to identify operational risks, confirm mitigations are in place, and make sure changes meet safety and regulatory requirements.
* **Coordinate rollouts and close the loop.** Plan phased or market-by-market rollouts, serve as the single point of coordination at launch, and run retrospectives to improve the process.

**What We're Looking For**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Operations Management, Business, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 5+ years of experience in program management, operations, or launch management.
* Experience managing cross-functional programs with several stakeholders, including technical engineering teams.
* Experience building or running an issue triage, intake, or escalation process.
* Working knowledge of lean principles and process standardization.
* Experience preparing operations teams for product, technology, or process changes.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, including turning technical information into clear operational guidance.
* Experience with program management and issue tracking tools such as Jira, Confluence, Asana, or Smartsheet.
* Experience in autonomous vehicles, trucking, logistics, or fleet operations preferred.
* Lean Six Sigma Yellow or Green Belt, or equivalent lean training preferred.
* Experience supporting software or hardware release cycles in a technology or robotics environment preferred.
* Familiarity with safety-critical operations and change management processes preferred.
* Experience working with training and enablement teams to roll out SOPs and field training preferred.
* PMP, CSM, or similar program management certification preferred.
* Experience in a high-growth or startup environment preferred.

**More about Gatik**

Founded in 2017 by experts in autonomous vehicle technology, Gatik has rapidly expanded its presence to Mountain View, Dallas-Fort Worth, Arkansas, and Toronto. As the *first and only* company to achieve fully driverless middle-mile commercial deliveries, Gatik holds a unique and defensible position in the AV industry, with a clear trajectory toward sustainable growth and profitability.

We have delivered complete, proprietary AV technology - an integration of software and hardware - to enable earlier successes for our clients in constrained Level 4 autonomy.

new_jobs.title: Office Manager
new_jobs.description:
**ABOUT US**
------------

We're building toward a world where every company can become its own AI lab.

Goaly is an early-stage AI startup founded by ex-Meta Superintelligence Labs engineers and researchers who built the Llama Research Platform and led post-training efficiency on Meta's Superintelligence team. Goaly is the autonomous performance layer for AI training: it watches every job across a GPU fleet, catches the runs that are wasting compute, and shows teams what each model improvement actually costs.

Backed by leading AI investors, we're looking for the person who makes our Palo Alto office run: the one who notices what's missing before anyone else does and fixes it the same day.

**ABOUT THE ROLE**
------------------

You will be our first Office Manager and you will own the office end to end. Our team works in person, and the office has to work every day: stocked, fed, clean, secure, and ready for whoever walks in, whether that's a new hire, a candidate in for an onsite, or a visiting customer.

The job is three things: keep the office running (supplies, food, facilities, vendors, budget, mail); make first days and visits great (onboarding, candidate and guest hospitality, on-site events); and be the operational backbone for a small team (light scheduling, travel, and expense support for the founders and business team).

You report to the Head of Business & Operations and work daily with the founders, engineering, and the go-to-market team. There is no office playbook yet; you write it.

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**
------------------

**Run the office**

* Own office supplies: track inventory and reorder before anything runs out.
* Run the meals program: extra order of lunch and dinner, snacks and drinks, dietary needs, and the budget. Food is a core perk here and it never slips.
* Keep the kitchen and common areas clean, stocked, and working.
* Be the point of contact for building and property management: badges and keys, HVAC, cleaning, repairs, parking, and weekend access.
* Handle mail, packages, and shipping and receiving, including hardware and employee equipment.
* Keep the layout working as we grow: desks, seating, furniture. When the time comes, lead the next office search, build-out, and move.

**Keep it safe and secure**

* Own access control: badges issued and revoked on first and last days, visitor sign-in, and a monthly review of who has access.
* Keep first-aid kits, evacuation materials, and emergency contacts current, and schedule drills with the building.
* Be first point of contact for minor incidents and facility problems; escalate the rest.

**Welcome new hires, candidates, and guests**

* Host candidate onsites: greet, keep the day on schedule, rooms and interviewers ready, meals and travel reimbursement handled.
* Be the front door for visitors and customers, with conference rooms set up and working.
* Run on-site logistics for events we host (meetups, workshops, hackathons) and plan team lunches, offsites, and celebrations.

**Support the founders and business team**

* Calendars, scheduling, and travel; receipts, expenses, and vendor invoices with our finance partner.
* Swag program and ad hoc projects: printing, notarizations, errands, bank and government paperwork.

**Write the playbook**

* Stand up one place for office requests with a response standard the team can count on.
* Document how the office runs (vendors, ordering, onboarding, visitors, emergencies) so someone else could keep the lights on if you were out for a week.
* Keep a simple view of spend, vendors, inventory, and recurring requests. Fix what repeats.

**YOU MAY BE A GOOD FIT IF YOU HAVE**
-------------------------------------

**Minimum**

* 2+ years running a physical space and the people in it: office manager, workplace or facilities coordinator, executive assistant, or a front-of-house or hospitality role with real operational scope. Startup experience is a plus, not a requirement.
* Strong organization and follow-through: you keep lists, close loops, and nothing you own runs out.
* Warm and professional with everyone, from founders and customers to candidates and delivery drivers.
* Comfort with Google Workspace, Slack, spreadsheets, and vendor portals, and fluent with AI tools (Claude or similar) for drafting, research, and tracking.
* Discretion with confidential information, and a self-starter who fixes what is missing without being asked.
* Able to work five days a week in our Palo Alto office and to be the first one in most mornings.

**Preferred**

* **Big bonus:** prior office management or operations experience at an AI company or AI lab.
* Only person doing this job at an early-stage startup (under 50 people).
